title: Understanding Issues, Causes and Solutions in Open-Source LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 理解开源 LLM 多智能体系统中的问题、原因与解决方案

paragraphs.en: With the advancement of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), an increasing number of open-source projects are adopting multi-agent architectures as the foundation of their core functionality. Although research and practice on MAS have attracted considerable attention, limited studies have explored the challenges faced by practitioners of open-source LLM-based MAS, the causes of these challenges, and potential solutions. To address this gap, we conducted an empirical study to understand the issues that practitioners encounter when developing and using open-source LLM-based MAS, the possible causes of these issues, and potential solutions. We collected 22,848 closed issues from 21 open-source LLM-based MAS and applied a mixed automated and manual filtering approach to reduce the dataset to 944 issues related to LLM-based MAS. We then analyzed these issues to understand the frequent issues encountered by practitioners, their underlying causes, and potential solutions. Our study results show that (1) Orchestration & Execution Issue is the most common issue faced by practitioners, (2) Workflow Problem , Tool Integration Problem , and Memory Problem are identified as the most frequent causes of the issues, and (3) Optimize Workflow is the predominant solution to the issues. Based on the study results, we derive empirically grounded implications for practitioners and researchers aimed at improving orchestration, tool integration, and memory mechanisms in LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 随着基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）的进步，越来越多的开源项目开始采用多智能体架构作为其核心功能的基础。 尽管对多智能体系统的研究与实践已引起广泛关注，但针对开源大型语言模型多智能体系统实践者所面临的挑战、这些挑战的原因以及潜在解决方案的研究仍十分有限。 为填补这一研究空白，我们开展了一项实证研究，旨在了解实践者在开发和使用开源大型语言模型多智能体系统时遇到的问题、这些问题可能的原因以及潜在的解决方案。 我们从21个开源的大型语言模型多智能体系统中收集了22,848个已关闭的问题，并通过混合自动化与人工筛选的方法，将数据集缩减至944个与大型语言模型多智能体系统相关的问题。 随后，我们对这些问题进行了分析，以了解实践者经常遇到的具体问题、其根本原因以及潜在的解决方案。 我们的研究结果表明：（1）“协调与执行问题”是实践者面临的最常见问题；（2）“工作流问题”、“工具集成问题”和“记忆问题”被认定为导致这些问题的最频繁原因；（3）“优化工作流”是解决这些问题的主要方案。 基于研究结果，我们提炼出具有实证依据的实践建议，旨在帮助实践者和研究人员改进大型语言模型多智能体系统中的协调机制、工具集成机制和记忆机制。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming the landscape of software development, moving us beyond simple coding copilots to a future where specialized LLM-powered agents actively collaborate like a digital team ( Hou et al., 2024 ) . Since the release of ChatGPT in 2022 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) , research on LLMs has grown rapidly ( Zhao et al., 2023a ) . The software engineering (SE) community quickly recognized their potential and began applying LLMs throughout the software development lifecycle ( Hou et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Early studies examined single-agent scenarios, where an LLM assists developers with code generation, code review, software testing, and requirements documentation ( Fan et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正在改变软件开发领域，使我们超越了简单的编码协作者，迈向一个由专门的大型语言模型驱动的智能体像数字团队一样积极协作的未来（Hou 等，2024）。 自 2022 年 ChatGPT 发布以来（OpenAI，2025a），关于大型语言模型的研究迅速增长（Zhao 等，2023a）。 软件工程（SE）界很快认识到它们的潜力，并开始将大型语言模型应用于整个软件开发生命周期（Hou 等，2024；Wang 等，2024）。 早期研究探讨了单智能体场景，即一个大型语言模型协助开发者进行代码生成、代码审查、软件测试和需求文档编写（Fan 等，2023）。

sents.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming the landscape of software development, moving us beyond simple coding copilots to a future where specialized LLM-powered agents actively collaborate like a digital team ( Hou et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multi-agent frameworks have enabled the development of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), in which multiple specialized LLM-powered agents communicate, coordinate, and collaborate to accomplish complex, sequential software engineering tasks that were previously too difficult for a single LLM agent ( He et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . This architectural approach is well-suited for complex end-to-end software processes because it addresses the inherent limitations of individual LLMs, including limited context windows, error propagation, and difficulties in managing complex software development workflows ( He et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体框架的最新进展使得基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）得以开发，在这些系统中，多个由 LLM 赋能的专用智能体通过通信、协调与协作，完成此前单个 LLM 智能体难以处理的复杂、顺序化的软件工程任务（He et al., 2025b；Liu et al., 2026）。 这种架构方法非常适合复杂的端到端软件流程，因为它解决了单个 LLM 的固有局限性，包括上下文窗口有限、错误传播以及难以管理复杂的软件开发工作流程等问题（He et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Recent advances in multi-agent frameworks have enabled the development of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), in which multiple specialized LLM-powered agents communicate, coordinate, and collaborate to accomplish complex, sequential software engineering tasks that were previously too difficult for a single LLM agent ( He et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, software practitioners are increasingly integrating LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) into their software projects. Frameworks such as LangChain and Semantic Kernel facilitate the development of these systems, supporting a wide range of applications from code generation to system design ( Chase, 2024 ; Microsoft, 2024 ) . Recent surveys have examined the use of LLMs in SE, analyzing model usage, dataset creation, and evaluation methods ( Hou et al., 2024 ) . Despite the rapid adoption and significant potential of LLM-based MAS ( Guo et al., 2024 ) , there remains a lack of empirical studies regarding the challenges associated with their development and maintenance in real-world contexts. From an SE perspective, the complexity of agent coordination, planning, and interaction introduces novel challenges that are not yet fully understood.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，软件从业者正越来越多地将基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）整合到他们的软件项目中。 LangChain 和 Semantic Kernel 等框架促进了这些系统的开发，支持从代码生成到系统设计的广泛应用（Chase, 2024；Microsoft, 2024）。 近期的综述研究探讨了大型语言模型在软件工程中的使用，分析了模型的使用方式、数据集的构建以及评估方法（Hou et al., 2024）。 尽管基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统得到了快速应用并展现出巨大潜力（Guo et al., 2024），但在现实场景下，关于其开发和维护所面临挑战的经验性研究仍然不足。 从软件工程的角度来看，智能体之间的协调、规划与交互的复杂性带来了许多尚未被完全理解的新挑战。

paragraphs.en: This study addresses this gap by conducting a comprehensive empirical analysis of prominent open-source systems (OSS) that incorporate LLM-based MAS as core architectural components. We collected 22,848 closed issues from relevant GitHub repositories whose documentation explicitly describes them as MAS projects. GitHub is the leading platform for hosting OSS projects and is widely used in empirical SE research ( Alrashedy and Binjahlan, 2024 ) . Our approach of analyzing closed issues from prominent OSS projects follows well-established practices in empirical SE ( Waseem et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2025b ) . By analyzing issue tracking data, our study directly observes the practical issues and root causes that developers encounter, as well as the solutions they employ when building and maintaining LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究通过针对那些将基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）作为核心架构组件的知名开源系统（OSS）进行全面实证分析，填补了这一研究空白。 我们从相关 GitHub 仓库中收集了 22,848 个已关闭的问题，这些仓库的文档明确将其描述为 MAS 项目。 GitHub 是托管开源项目的主要平台，在实证软件工程研究中也被广泛使用（Alrashedy 和 Binjahlan，2024）。 我们分析知名开源项目中已关闭问题的方法遵循了实证软件工程领域久经验证的实践（Waseem 等人，2026；Cai 等人，2025b）。 通过分析问题跟踪数据，我们的研究直接观察到了开发者在构建和维护基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统时所遇到的实际问题与根本原因，以及他们采用的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: A motivating example: Figure 1 presents a sample GitHub issue ( CrewAI issue #2606 ) from an LLM-based MAS project in which a developer reports a type validation issue where the manager agent passes structured dictionary inputs while the schema expects string values. To ensure consistency, the developer proposes enforcing a JSON message format, thereby highlighting an Orchestration & Execution Issue . Overall, the issue highlights a type mismatch in multi-agent coordination within LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 一个具有启发性的例子：图 1 展示了一个基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）项目中的 GitHub 问题示例（CrewAI 问题 #2606），其中一名开发者报告了一个类型验证问题：管理智能体传递了结构化字典输入，而模式却期望字符串值。 为确保一致性，该开发者提议强制执行 JSON 消息格式，从而凸显出一个编排与执行问题。 总体而言，该问题揭示了基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中多智能体协作时存在的类型不匹配问题。

paragraphs.en: Our study aims to identify the issues in developing and using open-source LLM-based MAS and to determine the causes of these issues, as well as possible solutions . With this aim in mind, we formulate three Research Questions (RQs):
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究旨在识别开发和使用基于开源大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）过程中存在的问题，确定这些问题产生的原因，以及可能的解决方案。 基于这一目标，我们提出了三个研究问题（RQs）：

sents.en: Our study aims to identify the issues in developing and using open-source LLM-based MAS and to determine the causes of these issues, as well as possible solutions .
sents.zh: 我们的研究旨在识别开发和使用基于开源大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）过程中存在的问题，确定这些问题产生的原因，以及可能的解决方案。

sents.en: With this aim in mind, we formulate three Research Questions (RQs):
sents.zh: 基于这一目标，我们提出了三个研究问题（RQs）：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 : What issues do practitioners face when working on LLM-based MAS?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：从业者在基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）开发中会面临哪些挑战？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 : What are the underlying causes of the issues in LLM-based MAS?
paragraphs.zh: 问题2：基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中存在问题的根本原因是什么？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 : What are the potential solutions to address the issues in LLM-based MAS?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：解决基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中存在问题的潜在方案有哪些？

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ1–RQ3, we analyzed the filtered set of 944 GitHub issues to identify the issues reported by practitioners, examine their underlying causes, and the solutions adopted in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答研究问题 RQ1–RQ3，我们分析了经过筛选的 944 个 GitHub 问题集合，以识别由从业者报告的问题，考察其根本原因以及实践中采用的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Our findings show that: (1) Orchestration & Execution Issue is the most common issue faced by practitioners, (2) Workflow Problem , Tool Integration Problem , and Memory Problem are identified as the most frequent causes of the issues, and (3) Optimize Workflow and Adjust Configuration are the predominant solutions to the issues in LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明：(1) 编排与执行问题是从业者面临的最常见的问题；(2) 工作流问题、工具集成问题和记忆问题被认定为这些问题最频繁的原因；以及 (3) 优化工作流和调整配置是 LLM 基 MAS 中解决这些问题的主要方案。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this work are threefold: (1) We identify the key issues that occur during the development of LLM-based MAS projects using the dataset ( Rehman et al., 2026 ) and organize them into a two-level taxonomy to provide a hierarchical understanding of their characteristics. (2) We identify the root causes of these issues and document the corresponding solutions proposed and adopted by practitioners, organizing both into taxonomies for causes and solutions. (3) We establish and analyze the mapping relationships between the identified issues and their underlying causes, as well as between the issues and their associated solutions, to better understand how issues are triggered and addressed in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的主要贡献有三方面：(1) 我们利用该数据集（Rehman et al., 2026）识别出基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统项目开发过程中出现的关键问题，并将其组织成一个两级分类体系，以提供对其特征的层级化理解。 (2) 我们识别了这些问题的根本原因，并记录了从业者提出和采用的相应解决方案，将原因和解决方案分别组织成分类体系。 (3) 我们建立了已识别问题与其潜在原因之间的映射关系，以及问题与其相关解决方案之间的映射关系，并进行分析，以更好地理解问题在实践中是如何被触发和解决的。

paragraphs.en: This study follows a systematic, multi-stage research methodology to investigate the practitioner-reported issues, underlying causes, and corresponding solutions in open-source LLM-based MAS. Based on this objective, we formulate three Research Questions (RQs) to guide the subsequent phases of the study and ensure a structured and reproducible analysis process, as shown in Figure 2 . The research process comprises the formulation of RQs in Section 2.1 , data collection in Section 2.2 , data filtering and labeling in Section 2.3 , data extraction in Section 2.4 , and data analysis in Section 2.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 本研究遵循一种系统化的多阶段研究方法论，旨在探究实践者报告的开源 LLM 基 MAS 中的问题、潜在原因及相应解决方案。 基于这一目标，我们提出了三个研究问题（RQs），以指导研究的后续阶段，并确保分析过程具有结构性和可重复性，如圖 2 所示。 研究过程包括第 2.1 节的研究问题构建、第 2.2 节的数据收集、第 2.3 节的数据筛选与标注、第 2.4 节的数据提取以及第 2.5 节的数据分析。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: What issues do practitioners face when working on MAS?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：从业者在从事多智能体系统工作时面临哪些挑战？

paragraphs.en: Rationale : As stated in Section 1 , recent advances in LLMs ( Zhao et al., 2023a ) have led to a rapid increase in OSS that use LLMs as core components for building intelligent agents (i.e., LLM-based MAS). This RQ aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the issues faced by OSS software engineers while developing MAS. This understanding provides an empirical foundation for identifying the critical challenges that require attention in the design and development of LLM-based MAS. Therefore, identifying and analyzing these practical difficulties is a fundamental first step in this study.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：如第 1 节所述，大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展（Zhao 等人，2023a）已导致使用 LLM 作为构建智能体核心组件的开源软件（OSS）迅速增加（即基于 LLM 的多智能体系统）。 本研究问题旨在全面理解开源软件工程师在开发多智能体系统时所面临的问题。 这种理解为识别基于 LLM 的多智能体系统在设计和发展中需要关注的关键挑战提供了经验基础。 因此，识别并分析这些实际困难是本研究的基本第一步。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: What are the underlying causes of the issues in a MAS?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：MAS 中问题的根本原因是什么？

paragraphs.en: Rationale : Following the identification of issues currently faced by practitioners in RQ1 , it is necessary to determine their underlying causes. Identifying these root causes allows this study to provide more practical and actionable recommendations for developing effective, context-specific solutions. Additionally, these insights can inform the ongoing refinement and optimization of both LLM-based MAS and the underlying foundation models.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：在识别出研究问题1中从业者目前面临的问题之后，有必要确定这些问题的根本原因。 识别这些根本原因有助于本研究为开发有效且符合具体情境的解决方案提供更实用、更具操作性的建议。 此外，这些见解还可以指导基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统及其底层基础模型的持续改进与优化。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: What are the potential solutions to address the issues in MAS?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：解决多智能体系统中存在问题的潜在方案有哪些？

paragraphs.en: Rationale : This RQ seeks to understand how OSS practitioners address the challenges encountered during the development and maintenance of LLM-based MAS. Answering this RQ will identify the most commonly adopted solutions within the MAS community and yield a diverse set of practical, practitioner-validated responses to the issues identified in RQ1 . By systematically exploring and analyzing these solutions, the study aims to provide actionable guidance for optimizing the design and implementation of LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本研究问题旨在了解开源软件从业者如何应对在开发和维护基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统时所遇到的挑战。 回答该研究问题将有助于识别多智能体系统社区中最常用的解决方案，并为研究问题1中确定的问题提供多样化、经过实践验证的实用应对方法。 通过系统性地探索和分析这些解决方案，本研究旨在为优化基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统的设计与实施提供具有操作性的指导。

paragraphs.en: We collected data for our study from GitHub repositories that clearly mention MAS in their documentation. GitHub is currently the largest platform for hosting OSS projects. In addition, every project on GitHub has an “Issues” page, which provides a platform for users and developers of the project to report issues experienced during development and usage, and to discuss the identification, analysis, and resolution of these issues with other users and developers. In order to thoroughly explore the causes of issues and their potential solutions, we collected all “closed” issues from the repositories of the selected LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 GitHub 仓库中收集了研究数据，这些仓库的文档中明确提到了 MAS。 GitHub 目前是最大的开源项目托管平台。 此外，GitHub 上的每个项目都有一个“问题”页面，该页面为项目的用户和开发者提供了一个平台，用于报告在开发和使用时遇到的问题，并与其他用户和开发者讨论这些问题的识别、分析和解决。 为了彻底探究问题的原因及其潜在解决方案，我们收集了所选基于 LLM 的 MAS 仓库中所有“已关闭”的问题。

paragraphs.en: To ensure comprehensive data collection, we did not set a start date for the data source. The date we performed the data search was November 16, 2025, and we collected all the closed issues created before this date. The first author utilized a keyword-based search approach, using the search terms “Multi-Agent System”, “Multi-Agent LLM”, and “AI Agents” to search across GitHub. Any project that contained these search terms (e.g., in the project description or tags) was retrieved. After obtaining the search results, we found that although many projects include the terms “Multi-Agent System”, “Multi-Agent LLM”, or “AI Agents”, they do not actually implement multi-agent architectures or utilize multiple LLM-based agents as core components. For example, some projects focus on teaching multi-agent concepts without building functional MAS. Therefore, we established the following criteria for selecting open-source LLM-Based MAS projects.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保数据收集全面，我们没有为数据源设定开始日期。 我们执行数据搜索的日期是 2025 年 11 月 16 日，并收集了在此日期之前创建的所有已关闭问题。 第一作者采用基于关键词的搜索方法，使用“Multi-Agent System”“Multi-Agent LLM”和“AI Agents”这些搜索词在 GitHub 上进行检索。 任何包含这些搜索词的项目（例如，在项目描述或标签中）都会被检索到。 在获取搜索结果后，我们发现尽管许多项目包含了“Multi-Agent System”“Multi-Agent LLM”或“AI Agents”这些术语，但它们实际上并未实现多智能体架构，也未将多个基于 LLM 的智能体作为核心组件使用。 例如，一些项目专注于教授多智能体概念，但并未构建功能完整的 MAS。 因此，我们制定了以下标准来选择开源的基于 LLM 的 MAS 项目。

sents.en: Therefore, we established the following criteria for selecting open-source LLM-Based MAS projects.
sents.zh: 因此，我们制定了以下标准来选择开源的基于 LLM 的 MAS 项目。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the inclusion and exclusion criteria used in this study. We defined an inclusion criterion (I5) to select projects that utilize multi-agent LLM architectures as core architectural components for their primary functionality. Following established empirical practices ( Cai et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2025 ) , we further applied the inclusion criterion (I1)–(I4) as benchmarks for evaluating project quality, activity, and popularity. By enforcing thresholds on star counts, contributor participation, issue resolution history, and recent update activity, we excluded inactive or unpopular repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 表1总结了本研究采用的纳入和排除标准。 我们定义了一项纳入标准（I5），用于筛选那些将多智能体大语言模型架构作为其核心功能主要架构组件的项目。 遵循既有的实证实践（Cai et al., 2025b；Lin et al., 2025），我们进一步将纳入标准（I1）–（I4）作为评估项目质量、活跃度和受欢迎程度的基准。 通过设定星标数量、贡献者参与度、问题解决历史以及近期更新活动的阈值，我们排除了不活跃或不受欢迎的仓库。

sents.en: Table 1 summarizes the inclusion and exclusion criteria used in this study.
sents.zh: 表1总结了本研究采用的纳入和排除标准。

sents.en: By enforcing thresholds on star counts, contributor participation, issue resolution history, and recent update activity, we excluded inactive or unpopular repositories.
sents.zh: 通过设定星标数量、贡献者参与度、问题解决历史以及近期更新活动的阈值，我们排除了不活跃或不受欢迎的仓库。

paragraphs.en: We prioritized projects with recent commit activity to ensure they reflect current MAS practices, and we manually verified whether each project explicitly described multi-agent collaboration rather than single-agent LLM usage. In addition, the exclusion criteria (E1) and (E2) were applied to remove educational, tutorial-oriented, or competition-based projects, as well as repositories that only reference multi-agent concepts without implementing actual multi-agent functionality. This selection process ensures that the final dataset is representative of established and actively maintained LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们优先选择了近期有提交活动的项目，以确保这些项目能反映当前的 MAS 实践；同时，我们还手动验证了每个项目是否明确描述了多智能体协作，而非单一智能体的 LLM 使用。 此外，我们还应用了排除标准 (E1) 和 (E2)，以剔除教育类、教程导向型或竞赛类的项目，以及那些仅提及多智能体概念但未实际实现多智能体功能的仓库。 这一筛选过程确保了最终数据集能够代表已成熟且正在积极维护的基于 LLM 的 MAS。

sents.zh: 这一筛选过程确保了最终数据集能够代表已成熟且正在积极维护的基于 LLM 的 MAS。

paragraphs.en: After applying the inclusion and exclusion criteria, we carefully examined the remaining repositories to ensure that they implemented LLM-based MAS and satisfied all selection requirements. Repositories that only partially met the criteria, lacked sufficient project information, or did not provide clear evidence of multi-agent functionality were excluded. Through this screening process, we identified a final set of 21 actively maintained open-source LLM-based MAS projects, which formed the basis of our subsequent analysis. Following the selection criteria, we ultimately included 21 open-source LLM-based MAS (see Table 2 ) that met our criteria. The domains of the 21 selected LLM-based MAS projects are categorized into six categories (see Table 3 ). Then, the first author employed web scrapers to collect all the closed issues from these project repositories. In the end, we gathered a total of 22,848 closed issues. Each closed issue was recorded in an MS Excel file. We named each MS Excel file using the convention: “ Project Name ” + “ _ ” + “ Issue Number ”.

paragraphs.en: We collected closed issues from 21 open-source LLM-based MAS and observed that not all reported issues were relevant to MAS-related problems. For example, some practitioners used issue trackers for community interaction or general inquiries, such as requesting access to a project’s Discord channel Agency-swarm #37 , without describing any technical problem in the MAS projects. We also identified issues that were purely single-agent in nature and did not involve multi-agent collaboration, despite being reported in MAS project repositories (e.g., Sdk-python #1435 ). In addition, we found that the issue labels were often too generic, and relying solely on existing labels could lead to missing relevant information. For example, the multi-agent Orchestration Issue reported in Autogen #6819 was assigned only the generic Bug label, making it difficult to identify through label-based filtering alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 21 个基于开源 LLM 的 MAS 项目中收集了已关闭的问题，并观察到并非所有报告的问题都与 MAS 相关的问题有关。 例如，一些实践者使用问题跟踪器进行社区互动或一般性咨询，例如请求访问某个项目的 Discord 频道 Agency-swarm #37，但并未描述任何与 MAS 项目相关的技术问题。 我们还发现了一些本质上属于单智能体问题且未涉及多智能体协作的问题，尽管这些问题是在 MAS 项目仓库中报告的（例如 Sdk-python #1435）。 此外，我们发现问题标签通常过于笼统，仅依赖现有标签可能会导致遗漏相关信息。 例如，在 Autogen #6819 中报告的多智能体编排问题仅被分配了“Bug”这一通用标签，这使得仅通过基于标签的筛选难以识别该问题。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges in filtering and labeling MAS-related issues, we adopted a two-stage mixed approach, combining automated and manual filtering methods to construct a high-quality dataset. This process focused on identifying closed issues that explicitly describe practitioner-reported problems related to MAS. Based on the pilot and formal filtering results in Section 2.3.1 and Section 2.3.2 , the final dataset was constructed and subsequently used for data extraction and analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决过滤和标记与 MAS 相关问题的这些挑战，我们采用了一种两阶段混合方法，将自动化过滤方法与人工过滤方法相结合，以构建一个高质量的数据集。 这一过程的重点是识别明确描述了从业者报告的与 MAS 相关问题的已关闭问题。 基于第 2.3.1 节和第 2.3.2 节中的试点和正式过滤结果，最终数据集得以构建，并随后用于数据提取和分析。

paragraphs.en: We conducted pilot data filtering by randomly selecting 100 closed issues from the collected dataset. The first and second authors independently labeled these issues to minimize potential personal bias. We observed that multi-agent issues were rare only 11 issues were related to real MAS issues, whereas non-multi-agent issues accounted for a relatively large proportion. Therefore, we adopted a mixed approach, combining automated and manual methods for data filtering, to ensure a high-quality dataset for our study. The pilot filtering results were compiled and recorded in MS Excel files ( Rehman et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从收集的数据集中随机选取了 100 个已关闭的问题，进行了初步的数据筛选。 第一作者和第二作者独立地对这些问题进行了标注，以尽可能减少潜在的个人偏见。 我们观察到，多智能体相关的问题非常罕见，仅有 11 个问题与真实的多智能体系统（MAS）问题有关，而非多智能体问题则占据了相对较大的比例。 因此，我们采用了一种混合方法，将自动化和手动方法相结合进行数据筛选，以确保为我们的研究提供高质量的数据集。 初步筛选的结果已整理并记录在 MS Excel 文件中（Rehman et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Therefore, we adopted a mixed approach, combining automated and manual methods for data filtering, to ensure a high-quality dataset for our study.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用了一种混合方法，将自动化和手动方法相结合进行数据筛选，以确保为我们的研究提供高质量的数据集。

sents.zh: 初步筛选的结果已整理并记录在 MS Excel 文件中（Rehman et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Automated Filtering : We applied a pilot automated filtering approach ( He et al., 2025a ) , following the methodology of prior studies demonstrating the effectiveness of LLM-based evaluation and automated assessment in software engineering tasks ( Zhou et al., 2025a ; Crupi et al., 2025 ) . We randomly selected 500 issues from the collected 22,848 closed issues and processed them with the DeepSeek-R1 model deployed locally via Ollama, with carefully crafted prompt instructions and iterative refinement to identify MAS-related issues ( Montes et al., 2025 ) . Using this approach, we identified 110 MAS-related issues.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化筛选：我们采用了一种初步的自动化筛选方法（He 等人，2025a），该方法遵循了先前研究的思路，这些研究已证明基于大型语言模型（LLM）的评估和自动化评估在软件工程任务中的有效性（Zhou 等人，2025a；Crupi 等人，2025）。 我们从收集到的 22,848 个已关闭问题中随机选取了 500 个问题，并通过 Ollama 在本地部署的 DeepSeek-R1 模型对其进行处理。我们精心设计了提示指令，并进行了迭代优化，以识别与 MAS 相关的问题（Montes 等人，2025）。 通过这种方法，我们识别出了 110 个与 MAS 相关的问题。

sents.en: We randomly selected 500 issues from the collected 22,848 closed issues and processed them with the DeepSeek-R1 model deployed locally via Ollama, with carefully crafted prompt instructions and iterative refinement to identify MAS-related issues ( Montes et al., 2025 ) .

sents.en: Using this approach, we identified 110 MAS-related issues.
sents.zh: 通过这种方法，我们识别出了 110 个与 MAS 相关的问题。

paragraphs.en: Manual Filtering : To ensure dataset quality, we did not fully rely on the LLM; therefore, manual filtering was also conducted. Two human coders, the first and second authors, were involved in this process. They labeled the same sample of 500 issues independently, which contained information related to problems encountered during the development or use of open-source LLM-based MAS. Inter-rater agreement between the two authors was measured using Cohen’s Kappa coefficient ( Cohen, 1960 ) , yielding a value of 0.82, which indicates a very high level of labeling consistency between the two authors. Any disagreements in the pilot labeling results were resolved through discussion involving the fourth author to reach a consensus. Finally, 102 out of the 500 closed issues were considered real multi-agent issues.
paragraphs.zh: 人工筛选：为确保数据集的质量，我们没有完全依赖 LLM；因此，还进行了人工筛选。 两名人类编码员（即第一作者和第二作者）参与了这一过程。 他们独立地对相同的 500 个问题样本进行了标注，这些样本包含了与开发或使用基于开源 LLM 的多智能体系统时遇到的问题相关的信息。 两位作者之间的评分者一致性通过 Cohen’s Kappa 系数（Cohen, 1960）进行测量，得出数值为 0.82，表明两位作者在标注上具有非常高的一致性。 试点标注结果中出现的任何分歧，都通过第四作者的参与讨论得以解决，最终达成一致意见。 最后，在 500 个已关闭的问题中，有 102 个被认定为真正的多智能体问题。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of Automated Filtering : To evaluate the effectiveness and accuracy of the DeepSeek-R1 model, we compared the automated filtering results with those of the manual filtering. Out of the 500 sampled issues, manual filtering labeled 102 multi-agent-related issues, while automated filtering labeled 110 such issues. The comparison between manual and automated labels yielded 452 agreements, where both methods produced consistent labels (i.e., auto=0, manual=0 or auto=1, manual=1), and 48 disagreements, where the labels differed (i.e., auto=1, manual=0 or auto=0, manual=1). We measured the agreement between the automated filtering results and the human annotations. Using this measure, the automated filtering approach achieved an agreement rate of 90.4%. To examine the 48 disagreements, we reviewed the cases where automated filtering labeled an issue as 0 but manual filtering labeled it as 1. In these cases, MAS concepts were not explicitly mentioned, and the relevance to MAS could only be determined from the issue context rather than explicit keywords. As a result, the LLM did not filter these issues as MAS-related issues. For example, Agentscope #489 does not explicitly describe a multi-agent issue, but its relevance to MAS is only clear from the context, not from explicit keywords. Conversely, in cases where automated filtering labeled an issue as 1 but manual filtering labeled it as 0, the issues often contained MAS-related terminology or project components, leading the LLM to filter them as MAS-related issues. However, during manual filtering, they were determined not to clearly describe practitioner-reported MAS-related issues. For example, PraisonAI #234 reports a dependency installation error but uses the term CrewAI , which is a MAS framework. Based on this keyword, the LLM classified it as a MAS-related issue. Similarly, Claude-flow #571 uses the phrase Hive Mind , which refers to MAS functionality, but it is actually a release announcement describing bug fixes and improvements rather than a practitioner-reported issue.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化过滤的评估：为评估 DeepSeek-R1 模型的有效性和准确性，我们将自动化过滤结果与人工过滤结果进行了比较。 在 500 个抽样问题中，人工过滤标记了 102 个多智能体相关的问题，而自动化过滤则标记了 110 个此类问题。 人工与自动化标签的比较结果显示：有 452 个一致情况（即两种方法给出的标签相同，如自动=0、人工=0 或自动=1、人工=1），以及 48 个不一致情况（即标签不同，如自动=1、人工=0 或自动=0、人工=1）。 我们测量了自动化过滤结果与人类标注之间的一致性。 使用这一衡量标准，自动化过滤方法实现了 90.4% 的一致性率。 为了分析这 48 个不一致的情况，我们审查了自动化过滤将问题标记为 0 而人工过滤将其标记为 1 的案例。 在这些案例中，并未明确提及 MAS 概念，其与 MAS 的相关性只能通过问题上下文判断，而非通过明确的关键词。 因此，大型语言模型未将这些问题过滤为多智能体相关的问题。 例如，Agentscope #489 并未明确描述一个多智能体问题，但只有从上下文中才能看出其与 MAS 的相关性，而非通过明确的关键词。 相反，在自动化过滤将问题标记为 1 而人工过滤将其标记为 0 的案例中，这些问题通常包含与 MAS 相关的术语或项目组件，导致大型语言模型将其过滤为多智能体相关的问题。 然而，在人工过滤过程中，这些案例被判定为未明确描述从业者报告的多智能体相关问题。 例如，PraisonAI #234 报告了一个依赖安装错误，但使用了 CrewAI 这一术语，而 CrewAI 是一个 MAS 框架。 基于这一关键词，大型语言模型将其分类为多智能体相关的问题。 类似地，Claude-flow #571 使用了 Hive Mind 这一短语，该短语指代 MAS 功能，但实际上这是一则描述错误修复和改进的发布公告，而非从业者报告的问题。

sents.en: Conversely, in cases where automated filtering labeled an issue as 1 but manual filtering labeled it as 0, the issues often contained MAS-related terminology or project components, leading the LLM to filter them as MAS-related issues.
sents.zh: 相反，在自动化过滤将问题标记为 1 而人工过滤将其标记为 0 的案例中，这些问题通常包含与 MAS 相关的术语或项目组件，导致大型语言模型将其过滤为多智能体相关的问题。

sents.en: However, during manual filtering, they were determined not to clearly describe practitioner-reported MAS-related issues.
sents.zh: 然而，在人工过滤过程中，这些案例被判定为未明确描述从业者报告的多智能体相关问题。

sents.en: For example, PraisonAI #234 reports a dependency installation error but uses the term CrewAI , which is a MAS framework.
sents.zh: 例如，PraisonAI #234 报告了一个依赖安装错误，但使用了 CrewAI 这一术语，而 CrewAI 是一个 MAS 框架。

sents.en: Based on this keyword, the LLM classified it as a MAS-related issue.
sents.zh: 基于这一关键词，大型语言模型将其分类为多智能体相关的问题。

sents.en: Similarly, Claude-flow #571 uses the phrase Hive Mind , which refers to MAS functionality, but it is actually a release announcement describing bug fixes and improvements rather than a practitioner-reported issue.
sents.zh: 类似地，Claude-flow #571 使用了 Hive Mind 这一短语，该短语指代 MAS 功能，但实际上这是一则描述错误修复和改进的发布公告，而非从业者报告的问题。

paragraphs.en: We conducted formal data filtering on the collected 22,848 closed issues. In this process, we excluded the issues not related to our study. We selected projects in which LLM-based MAS is a core component, and we kept those issues related to the problems that practitioners encountered during the development and use of open-source LLM-based MAS. As observed in the pilot study (see Section 2.3.1 ), the proportion of real MAS issues among the collected 22,848 closed issues was relatively low. Therefore, we adopted a mixed approach, combining automated and manual methods to construct a high-quality dataset. Accordingly, we first applied automated filtering to all 22,848 collected closed issues using the DeepSeek-R1 model deployed locally via Ollama, with carefully crafted prompt instructions and iterative refinement ( Montes et al., 2025 ) , to identify MAS-related issues ( He et al., 2025a ) . This automated filtering identified 2,335 multi-agent-related closed issues. To ensure dataset quality, we did not fully rely on the LLM; therefore, manual filtering was also conducted. The first author was involved in manually reviewing the results of the automated filtering to ensure data quality. Any disagreements in the formal data filtering results were resolved through discussion involving the fourth author to reach a consensus. Finally, 944 out of the 22,848 closed issues were considered real multi-agent issues. The source projects of the closed issues in the final dataset are presented in Table 4 . In addition, the distribution of the duration from issue opening to closing for the closed issues in the final dataset is shown in Figure 3 . The results of the formal data filtering were compiled and recorded in MS Excel files ( Rehman et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对收集到的 22,848 个已关闭问题进行了正式的数据筛选。 在此过程中，我们排除了与研究无关的问题。 我们选择了那些以 LLM 为基础的多智能体系统（MAS）作为核心组件的项目，并保留了与从业者在使用和开发开源 LLM 基础 MAS 过程中遇到的问题相关的那些问题。 正如在试点研究中观察到的那样（参见第 2.3.1 节），在收集到的 22,848 个已关闭问题中，真实 MAS 问题的比例相对较低。 因此，我们采用了一种混合方法，将自动化和手动方法相结合，以构建一个高质量的数据集。 据此，我们首先使用通过 Ollama 本地部署的 DeepSeek-R1 模型，结合精心设计的提示指令和迭代优化（Montes 等，2025），对所有 22,848 个已收集到的已关闭问题进行了自动化筛选，以识别与 MAS 相关的问题（He 等，2025a）。 此次自动化筛选识别出了 2,335 个与多智能体相关的已关闭问题。 为确保数据集的质量，我们没有完全依赖 LLM；因此，也进行了手动筛选。 第一作者参与了自动化筛选结果的manual审查，以确保数据质量。 正式数据筛选结果中出现的任何分歧，都通过第四作者的参与讨论得以解决，并最终达成共识。 最终，在 22,848 个已关闭问题中，有 944 个被认定为真实的多智能体问题。 最终数据集中已关闭问题的来源项目列于表 4。 此外，最终数据集中已关闭问题从提出到关闭的时间分布情况如图 3 所示。 正式数据筛选的结果已整理并记录在 MS Excel 文件中（Rehman 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: To answer the three RQs presented in Section 2.1 , we defined a set of data items for data extraction, as shown in Table 5 . The data items D1–D3 are used to extract information about issues, underlying causes, and solutions that address these issues, corresponding to RQ1–RQ3, respectively. These data items are extracted from different parts of the collected closed issues, including the title, description, and discussion. To ensure the accuracy of the data extraction results and the validity of the subsequent data analysis, we decided to conduct the data extraction manually. In addition, the dataset size is relatively small, making manual data extraction feasible. The details of the pilot and formal data extraction procedures are presented in Section 2.4.1 and Section 2.4.2 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答第 2.1 节中提出的三个研究问题（RQ），我们定义了一系列用于数据提取的数据项，如表 5 所示。 数据项 D1–D3 分别用于提取与研究问题 RQ1–RQ3 对应的问题、根本原因以及解决这些问题的方案的相关信息。 这些数据项是从已收集的已关闭问题的不同部分中提取的，包括标题、描述和讨论内容。 为确保数据提取结果的准确性以及后续数据分析的有效性，我们决定手动进行数据提取。 此外，数据集的规模相对较小，这使得手动数据提取具有可行性。 试点和数据提取正式流程的细节分别在第 2.4.1 节和第 2.4.2 节中介绍。

paragraphs.en: We randomly selected 100 closed issues from our filtered dataset. The first author then independently performed pilot data extraction on these issues. The results indicate that all three data items (see Table 5 ) can be extracted from our dataset. Based on the pilot extraction results, we reached a consensus and defined the following rules for formal data extraction. (1) In principle, only one issue is extracted from each closed issue; if multiple issues can be extracted, we record the first issue discussed. (2) If there are multiple causes mentioned in a closed issue, we record all the causes of the issue extracted in the former step, which are identified by the reporter and the development team. (3) Similarly, if there are multiple solutions mentioned in a closed issue, we record all the solutions identified by the reporter and the development team that can address the issue extracted in the former step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从筛选后的数据集中随机选取了 100 个已关闭的问题。 随后，第一作者独立地对这些问题进行了初步的数据提取。 结果表明，所有三项数据项（参见表 5）都可以从我们的数据集中提取出来。 基于初步提取的结果，我们达成了共识，并为正式的数据提取定义了以下规则。 （1）原则上，每个已关闭的问题仅提取一个问题；如果可提取多个问题，则记录第一个被讨论的问题。 （2）如果某个已关闭的问题中提到了多个原因，我们会记录在前一步骤中提取的所有问题原因，这些原因由报告人和开发团队共同确认。 （3）同样地，如果某个已关闭的问题中提到了多个解决方案，我们会记录报告人和开发团队共同确认的所有能够解决前一步骤中提取问题的方案。

After completing the data extraction, the second and fourth authors reviewed the results and discussed them with the first author to resolve inconsistencies and reach a consensus. Both authors further conducted multiple rounds of review and refinement to ensure the accuracy of the final dataset. The final results were compiled and recorded in an MS Excel file ( Rehman et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: During the formal data extraction, we identified 16 closed issues that contained multiple problems within a single GitHub issue report (e.g., CrewAI #3918 ). In accordance with our predefined criteria in Section 2.4.1 , we included only the first reported problem along with its corresponding causes and solutions. We also observed that not all closed issues contained clearly extractable information (i.e., causes or solutions). In some cases, the discussion was too vague to identify specific causes or solutions, while in others, issues were automatically closed due to inactivity, low priority, or high complexity, making it difficult to extract information.
paragraphs.zh: 在正式的数据提取过程中，我们识别出 16 个已关闭的问题，这些问题在单个 GitHub 问题报告中包含了多个问题（例如 CrewAI #3918）。 根据我们在第 2.4.1 节中预先设定的标准，我们仅纳入了第一个报告的问题及其相应的原因和解决方案。 我们还观察到，并非所有已关闭的问题都包含可以明确提取的信息（即原因或解决方案）。 在某些情况下，讨论内容过于模糊，难以识别具体的原因或解决方案；而在其他情况下，问题则因无活动、优先级低或复杂度高而自动关闭，使得信息提取变得困难。

paragraphs.en: After completing the data extraction, we performed data analysis to address the three RQs formulated in Section 2.1 . We applied the Open Coding and Constant Comparison methods, which are widely used in Grounded Theory for qualitative analysis in software engineering research ( Stol et al., 2016 ) . Open Coding represents the initial stage of analysis, where researchers systematically examine the text to identify key concepts and categories, assigning descriptive codes to each element. Constant Comparison follows as a refinement stage, in which researchers iteratively compare new data with previously coded data to adjust and integrate categories based on their similarities and differences.
paragraphs.zh: 在完成数据提取后，我们进行了数据分析，以解决第 2.1 节中提出的三个研究问题。 我们应用了开放式编码和恒定比较方法，这些方法在软件工程研究的定性分析中广泛用于扎根理论（Stol 等，2016）。 开放式编码是分析的初始阶段，研究人员在此阶段系统性地审查文本，以识别关键概念和类别，并为每个元素分配描述性代码。 恒定比较随后作为精炼阶段进行，研究人员在此阶段迭代地将新数据与先前已编码的数据进行比较，根据数据的相似性和差异调整并整合类别。

paragraphs.en: The steps in our data analysis are as follows: (1) The first author meticulously read through the text of each closed issue and assigned descriptive codes that succinctly summarize the core themes according to the three RQs (see Table 5 ). For example, Smolagents #1353 was coded as ‘‘Agent Tool Registration Failure’’ , which indicates an error caused by improper agent integration. (2) The first author compared commonalities and differences among codes. Following a bottom-up approach, identical or similar codes were grouped into higher-level types and categories. For example, the code from Smolagents #1353 , along with similar instances, constituted a Tool Invocation Error type under the broader Tool Issue category. (3) When uncertainties about code descriptions arose, the first author discussed them with the second and fourth authors to reach a consensus. Due to the iterative nature of constant comparison, the initial results underwent several modifications. (4) The fourth author reviewed and verified the initial analysis. Subsequently, all other authors reviewed the final results and made further refinements to improve the accuracy and consistency of the analysis. Any disagreements were resolved through discussion; after resolving 29 conflicts in issue categories, 24 in cause categories, and 22 in solution categories, we obtained the final data analysis results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据分析步骤如下：（1）第一作者仔细阅读了每个已关闭问题的文本，并根据三个研究问题分配了能够简洁概括核心主题的描述性编码（参见表5）。 例如，Smolagents #1353 被编码为“智能体工具注册失败”，表示由不当的智能体集成引起的错误。 （2）第一作者比较了各编码之间的共同点和差异。 采用自下而上的方法，将相同或相似的编码归入更高级别的类型和类别。 例如，来自 Smolagents #1353 的编码与类似实例一起，构成了“工具调用错误”这一类型，该类型属于更广泛的“工具问题”类别。 （3）当对编码描述存在不确定性时，第一作者会与第二和第四作者进行讨论，以达成共识。 由于持续比较具有迭代性质，初步结果经过多次修改。 （4）第四作者审查并验证了初步分析结果。 随后，所有其他作者审阅了最终结果，并进行了进一步调整，以提高分析的准确性和一致性。 任何分歧都通过讨论解决；在解决了问题类别中的29个冲突、原因类别中的24个冲突以及解决方案类别中的22个冲突后，我们获得了最终的数据分析结果。

sents.en: The steps in our data analysis are as follows: (1) The first author meticulously read through the text of each closed issue and assigned descriptive codes that succinctly summarize the core themes according to the three RQs (see Table 5 ).
sents.zh: 我们的数据分析步骤如下：（1）第一作者仔细阅读了每个已关闭问题的文本，并根据三个研究问题分配了能够简洁概括核心主题的描述性编码（参见表5）。

sents.en: For example, Smolagents #1353 was coded as ‘‘Agent Tool Registration Failure’’ , which indicates an error caused by improper agent integration.
sents.zh: 例如，Smolagents #1353 被编码为“智能体工具注册失败”，表示由不当的智能体集成引起的错误。

sents.en: (2) The first author compared commonalities and differences among codes.
sents.zh: （2）第一作者比较了各编码之间的共同点和差异。

sents.en: Following a bottom-up approach, identical or similar codes were grouped into higher-level types and categories.
sents.zh: 采用自下而上的方法，将相同或相似的编码归入更高级别的类型和类别。

sents.en: For example, the code from Smolagents #1353 , along with similar instances, constituted a Tool Invocation Error type under the broader Tool Issue category.
sents.zh: 例如，来自 Smolagents #1353 的编码与类似实例一起，构成了“工具调用错误”这一类型，该类型属于更广泛的“工具问题”类别。

sents.en: (3) When uncertainties about code descriptions arose, the first author discussed them with the second and fourth authors to reach a consensus.
sents.zh: （3）当对编码描述存在不确定性时，第一作者会与第二和第四作者进行讨论，以达成共识。

sents.en: Due to the iterative nature of constant comparison, the initial results underwent several modifications.
sents.zh: 由于持续比较具有迭代性质，初步结果经过多次修改。

sents.en: (4) The fourth author reviewed and verified the initial analysis.
sents.zh: （4）第四作者审查并验证了初步分析结果。

sents.en: Subsequently, all other authors reviewed the final results and made further refinements to improve the accuracy and consistency of the analysis.
sents.zh: 随后，所有其他作者审阅了最终结果，并进行了进一步调整，以提高分析的准确性和一致性。

sents.en: Any disagreements were resolved through discussion; after resolving 29 conflicts in issue categories, 24 in cause categories, and 22 in solution categories, we obtained the final data analysis results.
sents.zh: 任何分歧都通过讨论解决；在解决了问题类别中的29个冲突、原因类别中的24个冲突以及解决方案类别中的22个冲突后，我们获得了最终的数据分析结果。

paragraphs.en: We present the findings of the three RQs and discuss their implications. We introduce a two-stage classification for the Issue, Cause, and Solution taxonomies, where an Issue refers to a problem reported by practitioners in LLM-based MAS, a Cause represents the underlying reason for the problem, and a Solution describes the approach used to resolve it. The taxonomies consist of categories and types, and brief descriptions of each type are provided under the corresponding category. To demonstrate the relationships among issues, causes, and solutions, we present mappings between Issue and Cause categories, as well as between Issue and Solution categories. It should be noted that only closed issues for which a solution has been extracted are included in the issue solution mapping. Similarly, only closed issues for which a cause has been extracted are included in the issue cause mapping. The taxonomy of issues in the final dataset is shown in Figure 4 , while the distribution of their closure durations is presented in Figure 3 . To further interpret these findings, we identify key patterns in the results and examine their implications for issues, causes, and solutions in LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了三个研究问题（RQ）的研究结果，并讨论了其意义。 我们为“问题-原因-解决方案”分类体系引入了一种两阶段分类方法：其中，“问题”指从业者在使用基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-based MAS）时报告的问题；“原因”代表该问题的根本原因；而“解决方案”则描述用于解决该问题的方法。 该分类体系由多个类别和类型组成，每个类型的简要说明均列于其对应的类别下。 为了展示问题、原因和解决方案之间的关系，我们呈现了问题类别与原因类别之间的映射关系，以及问题类别与解决方案类别之间的映射关系。 需要注意的是，只有那些已解决且提取出解决方案的问题，才会被纳入问题-解决方案映射中。 同样地，只有那些已解决且提取出原因的问题，才会被纳入问题-原因映射中。 最终数据集中问题的分类体系如图4所示，而这些问题关闭时长的分布情况则如图3所示。 为了进一步解读这些研究结果，我们从结果中识别出关键模式，并分析了它们对基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-based MAS）中的问题、原因和解决方案所具有的意义。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows the taxonomy of the closed issues extracted from the dataset. The results show that Orchestration & Execution Issue (22.0%) is the most frequent category reported by practitioners in open-source LLM-based MAS projects, followed by Memory & State Management Issue (14.7%) and Feature Request (13.2%). Implementation Issue (10.6%) also represents a notable portion of the dataset. The remaining categories each account for less than 10%, including Tool Issue (9.2%), Integration Issue (6.7%), Role Issue (3.8%), Environment & Configuration Issue (3.5%), Output Issue (3.1%), Documentation Issue (2.8%), Communication Issue (2.6%), Performance Issue (2.0%), Model Issue (1.6%), Compatibility Issue (1.4%), Error Handling Issue (1.3%), Task Management Issue (1.2%), and Security Issue (0.3%).
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了从数据集中提取的已关闭问题的分类体系。 结果表明，协调与执行问题（22.0%）是开源 LLM 基 MAS 项目中从业者报告的最常见类别，其次是记忆与状态管理问题（14.7%）和功能请求（13.2%）。 实现问题（10.6%）在数据集中也占有一定比例。 其余各类别占比均低于 10%，包括工具问题（9.2%）、集成问题（6.7%）、角色问题（3.8%）、环境与配置问题（3.5%）、输出问题（3.1%）、文档问题（2.8%）、通信问题（2.6%）、性能问题（2.0%）、模型问题（1.6%）、兼容性问题（1.4%）、错误处理问题（1.3%）、任务管理问题（1.2%）以及安全问题（0.3%）。

paragraphs.en: (22.0%) Orchestration & Execution Issue refers to problems arising from agent orchestration and LLM-based execution control during runtime in the development and use of open-source LLM-based MAS. This category comprises the following ten issue types.
paragraphs.zh: (22.0%) 编排与执行问题是指在使用和开发基于开源 LLM 的多智能体系统时，运行期间因智能体编排和基于 LLM 的执行控制而产生的问题。 该类别包含以下十种问题类型。

sents.en: (22.0%) Orchestration & Execution Issue refers to problems arising from agent orchestration and LLM-based execution control during runtime in the development and use of open-source LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: (22.0%) 编排与执行问题是指在使用和开发基于开源 LLM 的多智能体系统时，运行期间因智能体编排和基于 LLM 的执行控制而产生的问题。

sents.en: This category comprises the following ten issue types.
sents.zh: 该类别包含以下十种问题类型。

paragraphs.en: Coordination & Handoff Issue refers to issues in interaction and task transfer between agents in LLM-based MAS. These issues usually arise when agents fail to properly coordinate or hand off tasks, leading to delays, duplication, unexpected outputs, or incomplete execution. For example, a practitioner reported that “ sub-agent could not correctly transfer to root agent and call the MCP tool ” (Adk-python #1039).
paragraphs.zh: 协调与交接问题是指基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中智能体之间互动和任务交接时出现的问题。 这些问题通常出现在智能体未能正确协调或交接任务时，导致延迟、重复操作、意外输出或执行不完整。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“子智能体无法正确转交至根智能体并调用 MCP 工具”（Adk-python #1039）。

sents.en: Coordination & Handoff Issue refers to issues in interaction and task transfer between agents in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: 协调与交接问题是指基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中智能体之间互动和任务交接时出现的问题。

sents.en: These issues usually arise when agents fail to properly coordinate or hand off tasks, leading to delays, duplication, unexpected outputs, or incomplete execution.
sents.zh: 这些问题通常出现在智能体未能正确协调或交接任务时，导致延迟、重复操作、意外输出或执行不完整。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ sub-agent could not correctly transfer to root agent and call the MCP tool ” (Adk-python #1039).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“子智能体无法正确转交至根智能体并调用 MCP 工具”（Adk-python #1039）。

paragraphs.en: Control Flow Error refers to issues where the execution order between agents or tasks does not behave as expected. These issues include incorrect sequencing, unexpected loop behavior, or disrupted execution flow, which may lead to incorrect outputs, execution failure, or early termination. For example, a practitioner reported that “ SequentialAgent doesn’t execute sub-agents after the first one ” (Adk-python #573).
paragraphs.zh: 控制流错误是指智能体或任务之间的执行顺序未按照预期运行的问题。 这些问题包括错误的顺序、意外的循环行为或中断的执行流程，可能导致错误的输出、执行失败或提前终止。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“SequentialAgent 在执行完第一个子智能体后就不再执行后续的子智能体了”（Adk-python #573）。

sents.en: Control Flow Error refers to issues where the execution order between agents or tasks does not behave as expected.
sents.zh: 控制流错误是指智能体或任务之间的执行顺序未按照预期运行的问题。

sents.en: These issues include incorrect sequencing, unexpected loop behavior, or disrupted execution flow, which may lead to incorrect outputs, execution failure, or early termination.
sents.zh: 这些问题包括错误的顺序、意外的循环行为或中断的执行流程，可能导致错误的输出、执行失败或提前终止。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ SequentialAgent doesn’t execute sub-agents after the first one ” (Adk-python #573).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“SequentialAgent 在执行完第一个子智能体后就不再执行后续的子智能体了”（Adk-python #573）。

paragraphs.en: Infinite Execution Loop refers to issues where agents become trapped in continuous execution without a valid termination condition. These issues arise from missing termination logic, weak control, or poor coordination, leading to resource waste and incomplete workflows. For example, a practitioner reported that “ agentic parallelization with different agents/tasks: tasks repeat in a loop, aggregator never runs, process never completes ” (PraisonAI #864).
paragraphs.zh: 无限执行循环是指智能体在没有有效终止条件的情况下陷入持续执行的问题。 这些问题源于终止逻辑的缺失、控制机制薄弱或协调不当，导致资源浪费和工作流不完整。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“不同智能体/任务的智能体并行处理：任务在循环中重复，聚合器从未运行，流程从未完成”（PraisonAI #864）。

sents.en: Infinite Execution Loop refers to issues where agents become trapped in continuous execution without a valid termination condition.
sents.zh: 无限执行循环是指智能体在没有有效终止条件的情况下陷入持续执行的问题。

sents.en: These issues arise from missing termination logic, weak control, or poor coordination, leading to resource waste and incomplete workflows.
sents.zh: 这些问题源于终止逻辑的缺失、控制机制薄弱或协调不当，导致资源浪费和工作流不完整。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ agentic parallelization with different agents/tasks: tasks repeat in a loop, aggregator never runs, process never completes ” (PraisonAI #864).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“不同智能体/任务的智能体并行处理：任务在循环中重复，聚合器从未运行，流程从未完成”（PraisonAI #864）。

paragraphs.en: Termination Failure refers to issues where execution continues even after a valid termination condition is met. These issues result from incorrect termination signaling or inconsistent stopping conditions, causing workflows to run longer than necessary. For example, a practitioner reported that “ termination on the receiving agent doesn’t terminate the program ” (Autogen #1919).
paragraphs.zh: 终止失败是指即使满足了有效的终止条件，执行仍然继续的问题。 这些问题源于不正确的终止信号或不一致的停止条件，导致工作流程的运行时间超过必要时长。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“接收智能体上的终止操作并未终止程序”（Autogen #1919）。

sents.en: Termination Failure refers to issues where execution continues even after a valid termination condition is met.
sents.zh: 终止失败是指即使满足了有效的终止条件，执行仍然继续的问题。

sents.en: These issues result from incorrect termination signaling or inconsistent stopping conditions, causing workflows to run longer than necessary.
sents.zh: 这些问题源于不正确的终止信号或不一致的停止条件，导致工作流程的运行时间超过必要时长。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ termination on the receiving agent doesn’t terminate the program ” (Autogen #1919).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“接收智能体上的终止操作并未终止程序”（Autogen #1919）。

paragraphs.en: Premature Termination refers to issues where execution stops before all agents complete their tasks. These issues arise from incorrect orchestration, early stopping, or faulty propagation, resulting in partial workflow execution. For example, a practitioner reported that “ multi-agent chain stops at first agent without executing others in v2.2.7 ” (Flowise #4321).
paragraphs.zh: 提前终止指的是在执行过程中，所有智能体尚未完成其任务时执行即停止的问题。 这些问题源于错误的协调机制、过早停止或故障传播，导致工作流仅部分执行。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在 v2.2.7 版本中，多智能体链在第一个智能体处停止，其余智能体未执行”（Flowise #4321）。

sents.en: Premature Termination refers to issues where execution stops before all agents complete their tasks.
sents.zh: 提前终止指的是在执行过程中，所有智能体尚未完成其任务时执行即停止的问题。

sents.en: These issues arise from incorrect orchestration, early stopping, or faulty propagation, resulting in partial workflow execution.
sents.zh: 这些问题源于错误的协调机制、过早停止或故障传播，导致工作流仅部分执行。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ multi-agent chain stops at first agent without executing others in v2.2.7 ” (Flowise #4321).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在 v2.2.7 版本中，多智能体链在第一个智能体处停止，其余智能体未执行”（Flowise #4321）。

paragraphs.en: Resource Limitation refers to issues where LLM-based MAS experience resource conflicts, shared tool contention, or time constraints. These issues result in execution hangs, failures, or early termination. For example, a practitioner reported that “ Claude-Flow swarm command consistently times out due to resource conflicts between the swarm execution and active Claude Code sessions ” (Claude-flow #59).
paragraphs.zh: 资源限制是指基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）在运行过程中出现的资源冲突、共享工具竞争或时间约束等问题。 这些问题会导致执行过程挂起、失败或提前终止。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“Claude-Flow 的 swarm 命令由于 swarm 执行与正在运行的 Claude Code 会话之间的资源冲突而持续超时”（Claude-flow #59）。

sents.en: Resource Limitation refers to issues where LLM-based MAS experience resource conflicts, shared tool contention, or time constraints.
sents.zh: 资源限制是指基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）在运行过程中出现的资源冲突、共享工具竞争或时间约束等问题。

sents.en: These issues result in execution hangs, failures, or early termination.
sents.zh: 这些问题会导致执行过程挂起、失败或提前终止。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ Claude-Flow swarm command consistently times out due to resource conflicts between the swarm execution and active Claude Code sessions ” (Claude-flow #59).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“Claude-Flow 的 swarm 命令由于 swarm 执行与正在运行的 Claude Code 会话之间的资源冲突而持续超时”（Claude-flow #59）。

paragraphs.en: Agent Selection Issue refers to issues where the routing or delegation mechanism fails to identify and assign the most appropriate specialized agent for a given task. These issues lead to incorrect agent selection or failed agent delegation decisions, resulting in incorrect or failed task execution. For example, a practitioner reported that “ manager llm doesn’t seem to be working properly and does not seem to delegate the query to other agents ” (CrewAI #1503).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体选择问题是指路由或委派机制未能识别并分配最适合特定任务的专业智能体的问题。 这些问题会导致错误的智能体选择或失败的智能体委派决策，进而导致任务执行错误甚至失败。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“manager llm 似乎没有正常工作，也没有将查询委派给其他智能体”（CrewAI #1503）。

sents.en: Agent Selection Issue refers to issues where the routing or delegation mechanism fails to identify and assign the most appropriate specialized agent for a given task.
sents.zh: 智能体选择问题是指路由或委派机制未能识别并分配最适合特定任务的专业智能体的问题。

sents.en: These issues lead to incorrect agent selection or failed agent delegation decisions, resulting in incorrect or failed task execution.
sents.zh: 这些问题会导致错误的智能体选择或失败的智能体委派决策，进而导致任务执行错误甚至失败。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ manager llm doesn’t seem to be working properly and does not seem to delegate the query to other agents ” (CrewAI #1503).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“manager llm 似乎没有正常工作，也没有将查询委派给其他智能体”（CrewAI #1503）。

paragraphs.en: Agent Design Issue refers to issues where agent architectural design, data flow, or inter-agent communication is difficult to define or implement in LLM-based MAS. These issues lead to challenges in chaining agents, handling structured data, or maintaining consistency across agent boundaries, resulting in orchestration errors or workflow breakdowns. For example, a practitioner reported that “ passing information between 2 agents is cumbersome ” (Agno #2391).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体设计问题是指基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中，智能体架构设计、数据流或智能体间通信难以定义或实施的问题。 这些问题导致在串联智能体、处理结构化数据或维持跨智能体边界的连贯性方面出现挑战，从而引发协调错误或工作流程中断。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在两个智能体之间传递信息非常繁琐”（Agno #2391）。

sents.en: Agent Design Issue refers to issues where agent architectural design, data flow, or inter-agent communication is difficult to define or implement in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: 智能体设计问题是指基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中，智能体架构设计、数据流或智能体间通信难以定义或实施的问题。

sents.en: These issues lead to challenges in chaining agents, handling structured data, or maintaining consistency across agent boundaries, resulting in orchestration errors or workflow breakdowns.
sents.zh: 这些问题导致在串联智能体、处理结构化数据或维持跨智能体边界的连贯性方面出现挑战，从而引发协调错误或工作流程中断。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ passing information between 2 agents is cumbersome ” (Agno #2391).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在两个智能体之间传递信息非常繁琐”（Agno #2391）。

paragraphs.en: Context Loss refers to issues where runtime contextual information (e.g., domain, task constraints, or user instructions) is not properly propagated between agents during execution. Agents ignore or revert to default values instead of following the intended context, leading to incorrect or unexpected behavior. For example, a practitioner reported that “ agents failed to consistently follow the specified domain context during multi-agent execution, repeatedly using the wrong domain example.com ” (PraisonAI #289).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文丢失是指在执行过程中，运行时上下文信息（例如领域、任务约束或用户指令）未能在智能体之间正确传递的问题。 智能体会忽略上下文或回退到默认值，而不是遵循预期的上下文，从而导致错误或不合预期的行为。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在多人智能体执行过程中，智能体未能始终遵循指定的领域上下文，反复使用了错误的域 example.com”（PraisonAI #289）。

sents.en: Context Loss refers to issues where runtime contextual information (e.g., domain, task constraints, or user instructions) is not properly propagated between agents during execution.
sents.zh: 上下文丢失是指在执行过程中，运行时上下文信息（例如领域、任务约束或用户指令）未能在智能体之间正确传递的问题。

sents.en: Agents ignore or revert to default values instead of following the intended context, leading to incorrect or unexpected behavior.
sents.zh: 智能体会忽略上下文或回退到默认值，而不是遵循预期的上下文，从而导致错误或不合预期的行为。

paragraphs.en: Concurrency Issue refers to issues where shared state is not properly managed when multiple agents execute in parallel. These issues arise when actions from different agents are processed in an unexpected order, potentially leading to inconsistent or incomplete context, runtime errors, or unstable behavior. For example, a practitioner reported that “ when running multiple agents in parallel, events coming from different agents can interleave ” (Adk-python #2404).
paragraphs.zh: 并发问题是指当多个智能体并行执行时，共享状态未被正确管理所引发的问题。 当不同智能体的操作以不可预见的顺序处理时，就会产生这类问题，可能导致上下文不一致或不完整、运行时错误或行为不稳定。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“当多个智能体并行运行时，来自不同智能体的事件可能会交错出现”（Adk-python #2404）。

sents.en: Concurrency Issue refers to issues where shared state is not properly managed when multiple agents execute in parallel.
sents.zh: 并发问题是指当多个智能体并行执行时，共享状态未被正确管理所引发的问题。

sents.en: These issues arise when actions from different agents are processed in an unexpected order, potentially leading to inconsistent or incomplete context, runtime errors, or unstable behavior.
sents.zh: 当不同智能体的操作以不可预见的顺序处理时，就会产生这类问题，可能导致上下文不一致或不完整、运行时错误或行为不稳定。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ when running multiple agents in parallel, events coming from different agents can interleave ” (Adk-python #2404).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“当多个智能体并行运行时，来自不同智能体的事件可能会交错出现”（Adk-python #2404）。

paragraphs.en: Interpretation : The high proportion of Orchestration & Execution Issue indicates that runtime coordination is the main challenge in LLM-based MAS. Coordination & Handoff Issue (62) and Control Flow Errors (40) are the most frequent types of issues in this category. Coordination & Handoff Issue reflect failures in task transfer between agents, while Control Flow Error indicate incorrect or unstable execution ordering. Overall, most issues arise from weak coordination between agents rather than limitations in individual agents. This indicates a gap between theoretical multi-agent design and practical execution reliability. The findings highlight orchestration as a key bottleneck and the need for better execution control and coordination mechanisms in future LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 解读：协调与执行问题的高比例表明，运行时协调是基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-based MAS）中的主要挑战。 协调与交接问题（62）和控制流错误（40）是该类别中最常见的问题类型。 协调与交接问题反映了智能体之间任务转移的失败，而控制流错误则表明执行顺序不正确或不稳定。 总体而言，大多数问题源于智能体之间的协调不足，而非单个智能体的局限性。 这表明理论上的多智能体设计与实际执行可靠性之间存在差距。 研究结果凸显了协调机制是关键瓶颈，并指出未来基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统需要更完善的执行控制与协调机制。

sents.zh: 总体而言，大多数问题源于智能体之间的协调不足，而非单个智能体的局限性。

sents.en: This indicates a gap between theoretical multi-agent design and practical execution reliability.

paragraphs.en: (14.7%) Memory & State Management Issue refers to issues in storing, updating, and propagating memory, state, or intermediate information across agents during execution. Practitioners encounter these challenges during the development and use of LLM-based multi-agent OSS. This category encompasses the following six types.
paragraphs.zh: (14.7%) 记忆与状态管理问题是指在执行过程中，跨智能体存储、更新和传递记忆、状态或中间信息时出现的问题。 从业者在开发和使用基于大型语言模型的多智能体开源系统时会遇到这些挑战。 这一类别包括以下六种类型。

sents.en: (14.7%) Memory & State Management Issue refers to issues in storing, updating, and propagating memory, state, or intermediate information across agents during execution.
sents.zh: (14.7%) 记忆与状态管理问题是指在执行过程中，跨智能体存储、更新和传递记忆、状态或中间信息时出现的问题。

sents.en: Practitioners encounter these challenges during the development and use of LLM-based multi-agent OSS.
sents.zh: 从业者在开发和使用基于大型语言模型的多智能体开源系统时会遇到这些挑战。

sents.en: This category encompasses the following six types.
sents.zh: 这一类别包括以下六种类型。

paragraphs.en: Context Loss refers to issues where persistent state or shared memory is not properly maintained or retrieved across agents during execution. Contextual information stored at higher levels is not consistently propagated or is reinitialized instead of being reused, causing agents to lose access to previously established states and leading to inconsistent or incorrect behavior across execution steps. For example, a practitioner reported that “ team shared context is lost whenever moving on to subsequent agent ” (Agno #3254).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文丢失指的是在执行过程中，跨智能体时持久状态或共享内存未能得到妥善维护或检索的问题。 存储在上层级的上下文信息未能一致地传递下去，反而被重新初始化而非重复使用，导致智能体无法访问先前建立的状态，从而在执行步骤中出现不一致或不正确的行为。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“每当转向后续的智能体时，团队的共享上下文就会丢失”（Agno #3254）。

sents.en: Context Loss refers to issues where persistent state or shared memory is not properly maintained or retrieved across agents during execution.
sents.zh: 上下文丢失指的是在执行过程中，跨智能体时持久状态或共享内存未能得到妥善维护或检索的问题。

sents.en: Contextual information stored at higher levels is not consistently propagated or is reinitialized instead of being reused, causing agents to lose access to previously established states and leading to inconsistent or incorrect behavior across execution steps.
sents.zh: 存储在上层级的上下文信息未能一致地传递下去，反而被重新初始化而非重复使用，导致智能体无法访问先前建立的状态，从而在执行步骤中出现不一致或不正确的行为。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ team shared context is lost whenever moving on to subsequent agent ” (Agno #3254).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“每当转向后续的智能体时，团队的共享上下文就会丢失”（Agno #3254）。

paragraphs.en: State Inconsistency refers to issues where shared state or intermediate outputs are not consistently visible, synchronized, or aligned across agents during execution. State updates are not reliably propagated, or different agents access different versions of the same state due to timing or synchronization issues, causing agents to operate on inconsistent state views, leading to unreliable or divergent execution behavior. For example, a practitioner reported that “ the second agent is often unable to see items stored in the state of the previous agent ” (Adk-python #1119).
paragraphs.zh: 状态不一致是指在执行过程中，共享状态或中间输出在智能体之间无法保持一致可见、同步或对齐的问题。 状态更新未能可靠地传播，或者由于时序或同步问题，不同智能体访问了同一状态的不同版本，导致智能体基于不一致的状态视图运行，从而引发不可靠或发散的执行行为。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“第二个智能体通常无法看到前一个智能体存储在状态中的项目”（Adk-python #1119）。

sents.en: State Inconsistency refers to issues where shared state or intermediate outputs are not consistently visible, synchronized, or aligned across agents during execution.
sents.zh: 状态不一致是指在执行过程中，共享状态或中间输出在智能体之间无法保持一致可见、同步或对齐的问题。

sents.en: State updates are not reliably propagated, or different agents access different versions of the same state due to timing or synchronization issues, causing agents to operate on inconsistent state views, leading to unreliable or divergent execution behavior.
sents.zh: 状态更新未能可靠地传播，或者由于时序或同步问题，不同智能体访问了同一状态的不同版本，导致智能体基于不一致的状态视图运行，从而引发不可靠或发散的执行行为。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ the second agent is often unable to see items stored in the state of the previous agent ” (Adk-python #1119).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“第二个智能体通常无法看到前一个智能体存储在状态中的项目”（Adk-python #1119）。

paragraphs.en: State Persistence Failure refers to issues where stored state or session-level information is not correctly initialized, preserved, or made accessible across agents during execution. State is not properly bound to session identifiers, or stored information becomes unavailable during runtime despite being explicitly defined, preventing agents from retrieving previously stored session state and leading to incomplete or incorrect execution. For example, a practitioner reported that “ team_session_state not initialized when session_id is provided ” (Agno #3799).
paragraphs.zh: 状态持久化失败是指在执行过程中，已存储的状态或会话级信息未能正确初始化、保留或在智能体之间被访问的问题。 状态未与会话标识符正确绑定，或者尽管信息已被明确定义，但在运行时却变得不可用，导致智能体无法检索先前存储的会话状态，从而引发执行不完整或不正确。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“当提供了 session_id 时，team_session_state 并未被初始化”（Agno #3799）。

sents.en: State Persistence Failure refers to issues where stored state or session-level information is not correctly initialized, preserved, or made accessible across agents during execution.
sents.zh: 状态持久化失败是指在执行过程中，已存储的状态或会话级信息未能正确初始化、保留或在智能体之间被访问的问题。

sents.en: State is not properly bound to session identifiers, or stored information becomes unavailable during runtime despite being explicitly defined, preventing agents from retrieving previously stored session state and leading to incomplete or incorrect execution.
sents.zh: 状态未与会话标识符正确绑定，或者尽管信息已被明确定义，但在运行时却变得不可用，导致智能体无法检索先前存储的会话状态，从而引发执行不完整或不正确。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ team_session_state not initialized when session_id is provided ” (Agno #3799).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“当提供了 session_id 时，team_session_state 并未被初始化”（Agno #3799）。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval Failure refers to issues where previously stored state, memory entries, or checkpoints cannot be reliably accessed during execution, even if they exist in the system. Agents fail to retrieve the required previous state, leading to incomplete workflow progression or reduced system reliability. For example, a practitioner reported that “ in a sequential agent workflow, the system randomly fails to retrieve stored checkpoints ” (Flowise #3859).
paragraphs.zh: 检索失败是指在执行过程中无法可靠访问先前存储的状态、记忆条目或检查点的问题，即使这些内容确实存在于系统中。 智能体无法检索到所需的先前状态，导致工作流程进展不完整或系统可靠性下降。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在一个顺序智能体工作流程中，系统会随机无法检索到已存储的检查点”（Flowise #3859）。

sents.en: Retrieval Failure refers to issues where previously stored state, memory entries, or checkpoints cannot be reliably accessed during execution, even if they exist in the system.
sents.zh: 检索失败是指在执行过程中无法可靠访问先前存储的状态、记忆条目或检查点的问题，即使这些内容确实存在于系统中。

sents.en: Agents fail to retrieve the required previous state, leading to incomplete workflow progression or reduced system reliability.
sents.zh: 智能体无法检索到所需的先前状态，导致工作流程进展不完整或系统可靠性下降。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ in a sequential agent workflow, the system randomly fails to retrieve stored checkpoints ” (Flowise #3859).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“在一个顺序智能体工作流程中，系统会随机无法检索到已存储的检查点”（Flowise #3859）。

paragraphs.en: Context Overflow refers to issues where accumulated contextual information exceeds the effective input or memory capacity of the system during multi-agent execution. Multiple agents continuously contribute information without filtering or compression, making the input context excessively large and leading to degraded performance or loss of relevant signals during reasoning. For example, a practitioner reported that “ a single agent needs to store information from multiple agents, which can lead to excessively long token lengths in the input for large models ” (Agentscope #637).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文溢出是指在多智能体执行过程中，累积的上下文信息超过了系统的有效输入或内存容量所引发的问题。 多个智能体在未经过滤或压缩的情况下持续贡献信息，导致输入上下文过大，从而在推理过程中造成性能下降或丢失关键信号。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“单个智能体需要存储来自多个智能体的信息，这可能导致大型模型的输入令牌长度过长”（Agentscope #637）。

sents.en: Context Overflow refers to issues where accumulated contextual information exceeds the effective input or memory capacity of the system during multi-agent execution.
sents.zh: 上下文溢出是指在多智能体执行过程中，累积的上下文信息超过了系统的有效输入或内存容量所引发的问题。

sents.en: Multiple agents continuously contribute information without filtering or compression, making the input context excessively large and leading to degraded performance or loss of relevant signals during reasoning.
sents.zh: 多个智能体在未经过滤或压缩的情况下持续贡献信息，导致输入上下文过大，从而在推理过程中造成性能下降或丢失关键信号。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ a single agent needs to store information from multiple agents, which can lead to excessively long token lengths in the input for large models ” (Agentscope #637).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“单个智能体需要存储来自多个智能体的信息，这可能导致大型模型的输入令牌长度过长”（Agentscope #637）。

paragraphs.en: State Loss refers to issues where parts of the generated or updated state are not retained in the final execution outcome. In multi-agent or parallel workflows, intermediate state updates are overwritten, dropped, or not properly merged during aggregation, causing some agent contributions to be missing from the final system state and resulting in incomplete or partial execution results. For example, a practitioner reported that “ state updates from parallel agent calls were not correctly aggregated, causing some agent contributions to be missing from the final session state ” (Adk-python #1153).
paragraphs.zh: 状态丢失是指生成的或更新的状态部分在最终执行结果中未被保留的问题。 在多智能体或并行工作流程中，中间状态的更新在聚合过程中会被覆盖、丢弃或未正确合并，导致某些智能体的贡献缺失于最终系统状态，从而产生不完整或部分执行结果。 例如，一位从业者报告称：“并行智能体调用的状态更新未被正确聚合，导致某些智能体的贡献缺失于最终会话状态”（Adk-python #1153）。

sents.en: State Loss refers to issues where parts of the generated or updated state are not retained in the final execution outcome.
sents.zh: 状态丢失是指生成的或更新的状态部分在最终执行结果中未被保留的问题。

sents.en: In multi-agent or parallel workflows, intermediate state updates are overwritten, dropped, or not properly merged during aggregation, causing some agent contributions to be missing from the final system state and resulting in incomplete or partial execution results.
sents.zh: 在多智能体或并行工作流程中，中间状态的更新在聚合过程中会被覆盖、丢弃或未正确合并，导致某些智能体的贡献缺失于最终系统状态，从而产生不完整或部分执行结果。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner reported that “ state updates from parallel agent calls were not correctly aggregated, causing some agent contributions to be missing from the final session state ” (Adk-python #1153).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者报告称：“并行智能体调用的状态更新未被正确聚合，导致某些智能体的贡献缺失于最终会话状态”（Adk-python #1153）。

paragraphs.en: Interpretation : The high proportion of Memory & State Management Issue indicates that state handling is a critical challenge in LLM-based MAS. Context Loss (42) and State Inconsistency (36) are the most frequently reported issues, showing a consistent pattern of unreliable state propagation across agents. There is a clear gap between the designed memory abstractions and their actual behavior in execution. This highlights the need for reliable state management and memory propagation mechanisms in future MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 解读：记忆与状态管理问题的高比例表明，状态处理是基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-based MAS）中的一个关键挑战。 上下文丢失（42）和状态不一致性（36）是最常被报告的问题，显示出跨智能体的状态传播存在持续的不稳定模式。 设计的记忆抽象与其在执行中的实际行为之间存在明显差距。 这凸显了未来多智能体系统（MAS）中需要可靠的州管理器和记忆传播机制。

sents.en: Interpretation : The high proportion of Memory & State Management Issue indicates that state handling is a critical challenge in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: 解读：记忆与状态管理问题的高比例表明，状态处理是基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-based MAS）中的一个关键挑战。

sents.en: Context Loss (42) and State Inconsistency (36) are the most frequently reported issues, showing a consistent pattern of unreliable state propagation across agents.
sents.zh: 上下文丢失（42）和状态不一致性（36）是最常被报告的问题，显示出跨智能体的状态传播存在持续的不稳定模式。

sents.en: There is a clear gap between the designed memory abstractions and their actual behavior in execution.
sents.zh: 设计的记忆抽象与其在执行中的实际行为之间存在明显差距。

sents.en: This highlights the need for reliable state management and memory propagation mechanisms in future MAS.
sents.zh: 这凸显了未来多智能体系统（MAS）中需要可靠的州管理器和记忆传播机制。

paragraphs.en: (13.2%) Feature Request refers to practitioner-driven requests for new capabilities or enhancements in LLM-based MAS. These requests typically highlight gaps between existing system capabilities and real-world application needs. This category encompasses the following five types.
paragraphs.zh: (13.2%) 功能请求是指从业者提出的、针对基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统的新功能或增强需求的请求。 这些请求通常凸显了现有系统能力与真实世界应用需求之间的差距。 该类别包含以下五种类型。

sents.en: (13.2%) Feature Request refers to practitioner-driven requests for new capabilities or enhancements in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: (13.2%) 功能请求是指从业者提出的、针对基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统的新功能或增强需求的请求。

sents.en: These requests typically highlight gaps between existing system capabilities and real-world application needs.
sents.zh: 这些请求通常凸显了现有系统能力与真实世界应用需求之间的差距。

sents.en: This category encompasses the following five types.
sents.zh: 该类别包含以下五种类型。

paragraphs.en: Extensibility & Customization refers to requests for extending system flexibility to support custom configurations, models, or agent-specific behaviors in LLM-based MAS. For example, a practitioner requested “ textit Is it possible to define multiple (local) LLMs in the config.yaml for different agents?” (MetaGPT #1266).
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展性与自定义性指的是在基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中，请求扩展系统灵活性以支持自定义配置、模型或特定于智能体的行为。 例如，一位从业者曾提问：“textit 是否可以在 config.yaml 中为不同的智能体定义多个（本地）大型语言模型？”（MetaGPT #1266）。

sents.en: Extensibility & Customization refers to requests for extending system flexibility to support custom configurations, models, or agent-specific behaviors in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: 可扩展性与自定义性指的是在基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中，请求扩展系统灵活性以支持自定义配置、模型或特定于智能体的行为。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner requested “ textit Is it possible to define multiple (local) LLMs in the config.yaml for different agents?” (MetaGPT #1266).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者曾提问：“textit 是否可以在 config.yaml 中为不同的智能体定义多个（本地）大型语言模型？”（MetaGPT #1266）。

paragraphs.en: Communication & Data Flow refers to requests for improving how information is transmitted, streamed, or exposed across agents and system components in LLM-based MAS. These requests typically arise when intermediate outputs or interactions are not visible or are delayed during execution. For example, a practitioner requested “ a way to output or stream AgentFlows like Chat inside Flowise app ” (Flowise #2838).
paragraphs.zh: 通信与数据流指的是在基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中，如何改进信息在不同智能体和系统组件之间传输、流式传递或暴露方式的请求。 当中间输出或交互在执行过程中不可见或出现延迟时，通常会提出此类请求。 例如，一位从业者曾请求“一种能够像 Flowise 应用中的聊天功能一样输出或流式传递 AgentFlows 的方法”（Flowise #2838）。

sents.en: Communication & Data Flow refers to requests for improving how information is transmitted, streamed, or exposed across agents and system components in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: 通信与数据流指的是在基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中，如何改进信息在不同智能体和系统组件之间传输、流式传递或暴露方式的请求。

sents.en: These requests typically arise when intermediate outputs or interactions are not visible or are delayed during execution.
sents.zh: 当中间输出或交互在执行过程中不可见或出现延迟时，通常会提出此类请求。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner requested “ a way to output or stream AgentFlows like Chat inside Flowise app ” (Flowise #2838).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者曾请求“一种能够像 Flowise 应用中的聊天功能一样输出或流式传递 AgentFlows 的方法”（Flowise #2838）。

paragraphs.en: Monitoring & Debugging refers to requests for improving visibility into agent behavior, execution steps, and system-level activities in LLM-based MAS. These requests typically arise when practitioners cannot observe how agents make decisions or interact with tools and data during execution. For example, a practitioner requested “ observability of agents’ actions taken, tools used, and data accessed ” (AutoGen #2423).
paragraphs.zh: 监控与调试指的是旨在提升对智能体行为、执行步骤以及基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中系统级活动可见性的请求。 当从业者无法观察到智能体在执行过程中如何做出决策或与之交互的工具和数据时，通常会提出此类请求。 例如，一位从业者曾请求“对智能体所采取的行动、使用的工具以及访问的数据进行可观察性分析”（AutoGen #2423）。

sents.en: Monitoring & Debugging refers to requests for improving visibility into agent behavior, execution steps, and system-level activities in LLM-based MAS.
sents.zh: 监控与调试指的是旨在提升对智能体行为、执行步骤以及基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中系统级活动可见性的请求。

sents.en: These requests typically arise when practitioners cannot observe how agents make decisions or interact with tools and data during execution.
sents.zh: 当从业者无法观察到智能体在执行过程中如何做出决策或与之交互的工具和数据时，通常会提出此类请求。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner requested “ observability of agents’ actions taken, tools used, and data accessed ” (AutoGen #2423).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者曾请求“对智能体所采取的行动、使用的工具以及访问的数据进行可观察性分析”（AutoGen #2423）。

paragraphs.en: Framework Limitation refers to requests in multi-agent frameworks where certain capabilities or design requirements are not directly supported by the existing system design or API. These requests typically arise when the framework only supports simple sequential or instruction-based workflows, thereby limiting more structured orchestration designs. For example, a practitioner requested support for advanced orchestration patterns: “ The agent team API cannot handle complicated workflows or hierarchical multi-agent patterns ” (Agno #2209).
paragraphs.zh: 框架限制指的是在多智能体框架中，某些功能或设计要求无法由现有系统架构或 API 直接支持的需求。 这类需求通常出现在框架仅支持简单的顺序流程或指令驱动型工作流时，从而限制了更结构化的协调设计。 例如，一位实践者曾请求支持高级协调模式：“智能体团队 API 无法处理复杂的工作流或分层多智能体模式”（Agno #2209）。

sents.en: Framework Limitation refers to requests in multi-agent frameworks where certain capabilities or design requirements are not directly supported by the existing system design or API.
sents.zh: 框架限制指的是在多智能体框架中，某些功能或设计要求无法由现有系统架构或 API 直接支持的需求。

sents.en: These requests typically arise when the framework only supports simple sequential or instruction-based workflows, thereby limiting more structured orchestration designs.
sents.zh: 这类需求通常出现在框架仅支持简单的顺序流程或指令驱动型工作流时，从而限制了更结构化的协调设计。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner requested support for advanced orchestration patterns: “ The agent team API cannot handle complicated workflows or hierarchical multi-agent patterns ” (Agno #2209).
sents.zh: 例如，一位实践者曾请求支持高级协调模式：“智能体团队 API 无法处理复杂的工作流或分层多智能体模式”（Agno #2209）。

paragraphs.en: Performance & Scalability refers to requests aimed at improving execution speed, parallelism, and system throughput in multi-agent frameworks. These requests typically arise when current systems do not efficiently support large-scale agent execution or real-time control over running processes. For example, a practitioner proposed “ parallel agent spawning to improve execution speed and support real-time query control in multi-agent workflows ” (Claude-flow #781).
paragraphs.zh: 性能与可扩展性指的是旨在提升多智能体框架中执行速度、并行性和系统吞吐量的请求。 这些请求通常出现在当前系统无法高效支持大规模智能体执行或对运行中的进程进行实时控制时。 例如，一位从业者提出了“通过并行生成智能体来提升执行速度，并支持多智能体工作流程中的实时查询控制”（Claude-flow #781）。

sents.en: Performance & Scalability refers to requests aimed at improving execution speed, parallelism, and system throughput in multi-agent frameworks.
sents.zh: 性能与可扩展性指的是旨在提升多智能体框架中执行速度、并行性和系统吞吐量的请求。

sents.en: These requests typically arise when current systems do not efficiently support large-scale agent execution or real-time control over running processes.
sents.zh: 这些请求通常出现在当前系统无法高效支持大规模智能体执行或对运行中的进程进行实时控制时。

sents.en: For example, a practitioner proposed “ parallel agent spawning to improve execution speed and support real-time query control in multi-agent workflows ” (Claude-flow #781).
sents.zh: 例如，一位从业者提出了“通过并行生成智能体来提升执行速度，并支持多智能体工作流程中的实时查询控制”（Claude-flow #781）。

paragraphs.en: Interpretation : The Feature Request category shows that practitioners mainly focus on extending the capabilities of existing multi-agent frameworks. A clear pattern emerges in Extensibility & Customization (57) and Communication & Data Flow (27), where users request more flexible configurations and support for advanced design capabilities not directly available in existing frameworks. Overall, these findings indicate that current MAS frameworks are functional but still limited in flexibility, leading practitioners to request more adaptable and extensible system designs.
paragraphs.zh: 解读：功能请求类别表明，从业者主要关注扩展现有多智能体框架的功能。 在可扩展性与自定义（57）以及通信与数据流（27）方面呈现出明显的规律，用户要求更灵活的配置以及对现有框架中未直接提供的高级设计能力的支持。 总体而言，这些发现表明当前的多智能体系统框架虽然具备功能性，但在灵活性方面仍存在局限，因此从业者希望获得更具适应性和可扩展性的系统设计。

sents.en: Interpretation : The Feature Request category shows that practitioners mainly focus on extending the capabilities of existing multi-agent frameworks.
sents.zh: 解读：功能请求类别表明，从业者主要关注扩展现有多智能体框架的功能。

sents.en: A clear pattern emerges in Extensibility & Customization (57) and Communication & Data Flow (27), where users request more flexible configurations and support for advanced design capabilities not directly available in existing frameworks.
sents.zh: 在可扩展性与自定义（57）以及通信与数据流（27）方面呈现出明显的规律，用户要求更灵活的配置以及对现有框架中未直接提供的高级设计能力的支持。

sents.en: Overall, these findings indicate that current MAS frameworks are functional but still limited in flexibility, leading practitioners to request more adaptable and extensible system designs.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这些发现表明当前的多智能体系统框架虽然具备功能性，但在灵活性方面仍存在局限，因此从业者希望获得更具适应性和可扩展性的系统设计。

paragraphs.en: (10.6%) Implementation Issue refers to issues arising from incorrect or incomplete implementation in LLM-based MAS during development or runtime. This category encompasses the following seven types.
paragraphs.zh: (10.6%) 实现问题是指由于在开发或运行时，基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中存在错误或不完整的实现而引发的问题。 这一类别包括以下七种类型。

sents.en: (10.6%) Implementation Issue refers to issues arising from incorrect or incomplete implementation in LLM-based MAS during development or runtime.
sents.zh: (10.6%) 实现问题是指由于在开发或运行时，基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中存在错误或不完整的实现而引发的问题。

sents.en: This category encompasses the following seven types.
sents.zh: 这一类别包括以下七种类型。

paragraphs.en: Execution Logic Error refers to issues arising from incorrect or unintended execution behavior caused by flaws in implementation logic during runtime in LLM-based MAS. Function calls, control flow, or internal execution mechanisms do not behave as intended, leading to runtime errors or incorrect execution paths despite a correct intended design. For example, a practitioner reported that when an agent is copied, method references become mismatched: “ the copied version of the BoardAgent causes a KeyError when accessing hook_lists[self.process_all_messages] ” (AutoGen #1706).
paragraphs.zh: 执行逻辑错误是指在基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中，由于实现逻辑存在缺陷而在运行时引发的不正确或非预期的执行行为问题。 函数调用、控制流或内部执行机制未能按预期运行，尽管设计本身是正确的，但仍会导致运行时错误或错误的执行路径。 例如，一位从业者报告称，当一个智能体被复制时，方法引用会出现不匹配的情况：“BoardAgent 的复制版本在访问 hook_lists[self.process_all_messages] 时引发了 KeyError”（AutoGen #1706）。
