paragraphs.en: According to our study results, the following knowledge is required to develop and use open-source LLM-based MAS: (1) Developers need knowledge of designing and managing agent workflows and orchestration in LLM-based MAS. Our findings show that Workflow Problem (WP) accounts for 29.4% and ranks first among all identified causes. This indicates that developers need solid knowledge of agent coordination, handoff design, and execution flow management when developing LLM-based MAS. For example, a contributor reported that “ after invoking transfer_to_agent, the target agent did not respond and produced no output due to incomplete transfer of task-related information ” (Adk-python #2073), highlighting the importance of proper handoff design while developing LLM-based MAS. (2) Developers need to understand tool integration and execution in LLM-based MAS. According to our study results, Tool Integration Problem (TIP) accounts for 11.7% of all causes. This indicates that developers require knowledge of tool registration, schema validation, and concurrent tool access management when developing LLM-based MAS. For example, a developer reported that a “ tool deadlock occurred because the swarm could not access tools already locked by an active Claude Code session ” (Claude-flow #59), highlighting that knowledge of proper tool lifecycle management is essential when developing LLM-based MAS. (3) Developers need to understand memory management and state persistence in LLM-based MAS. Memory Problem (MP) accounts for 11.1% of all causes. For example, a developer explained that “ external memory failed to store new memories in Mem0 because the agent ID exceeded the allowed length ” (CrewAI #2985), indicating that knowledge of session persistence and state consistency is essential for developing reliable LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 根据我们的研究结果，开发和使用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）需要以下知识：(1) 开发者需要掌握在 LLM 基 MAS 中设计和管理智能体工作流程与协调的知识。 我们的研究结果表明，工作流程问题（Workflow Problem, WP）占所有已识别原因的 29.4%，位居首位。 这表明，在开发 LLM 基 MAS 时，开发者需要具备扎实的智能体协调、任务交接设计和执行流程管理知识。 例如，一位贡献者报告称：“在调用 transfer_to_agent 后，目标智能体未作出响应且没有输出，原因是任务相关信息未能完整传递”（Adk-python #2073），这凸显了在开发 LLM 基 MAS 时合理设计任务交接的重要性。 (2) 开发者需要理解 LLM 基 MAS 中的工具集成与执行机制。 根据我们的研究结果，工具集成问题（Tool Integration Problem, TIP）在所有原因中占 11.7%。 这表明，在开发 LLM 基 MAS 时，开发者需要具备工具注册、模式验证和并发工具访问管理的知识。 例如，一位开发者报告称：“由于集群无法访问已被活跃的 Claude Code 会话锁定的工具，导致出现工具死锁”（Claude-flow #59），这凸显了掌握合理的工具生命周期管理对于开发 LLM 基 MAS 至关重要。 (3) 开发者需要理解 LLM 基 MAS 中的内存管理与状态持久化机制。 内存问题（Memory Problem, MP）在所有原因中占 11.1%。 例如，一位开发者解释说：“由于智能体 ID 超过了允许的长度，外部内存未能将新记忆存储到 Mem0 中”（CrewAI #2985），这表明掌握会话持久化和状态一致性知识对于开发可靠的 LLM 基 MAS 至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Tool Integration Problem (TIP) accounts for 11.7% of all identified causes, with Tool Execution Problem and MCP Integration Problem being the most frequently observed types. A typical failure occurs when tools encounter deadlocks, resource contention, or schema mismatches at runtime in LLM-based MAS. For example, a practitioner reported that “ MCP tool calls failed during asynchronous GroupChat execution because the event loop was already running ” (Ag2 #1763), while another reported that “ VertexAI Search Tool failed when combined with a sub-agent because multiple tool types were not supported together ” (Adk-Python #2822). To avoid such failures, developers should provide standardized tool validation APIs that automatically check input/output schemas when tools are configured, enforce timeouts at the tool level, and check tool availability before execution in LLM-based MAS. Additionally, since concurrent tool access by multiple agents can cause session locks, connection failures, and timeouts, MAS frameworks should provide mechanisms for managing tool connections, handling tool connection failures, and retrying failed tool calls. One practitioner reported that “ managing tool connections through framework-provided lifecycle hooks (e.g., FastAPI lifespan in Agno) prevented MCP connection failures ” (Agno #4958), highlighting the importance of proper tool lifecycle management for reliable MCP integration in LLM-based MAS.

This finding is further supported by the root cause analysis, which identifies Workflow Problem (WP) as the most significant underlying factor, accounting for 29.4% of all reported causes. Moreover, Workflow Problem (WP) accounts for 57.0% of the causes associated with Orchestration & Execution Issue . This indicates that deficiencies in multi-agent workflow design, execution flow among agents, and inter-agent task coordination are major factors contributing to system-level failures in LLM-based MAS. We encourage researchers to shift their focus from enhancing individual agents reasoning capabilities toward developing robust orchestration frameworks that ensure reliable handoffs between agents, correct execution order across the agents, and appropriate termination conditions in LLM-based MAS. Specifically, future work could investigate the formal verification of agent workflows and the development of runtime monitoring mechanisms capable of detecting and correcting coordination anomalies, such as infinite loops and premature termination, before they propagate throughout the system.

paragraphs.en: Given the complex and dynamic behavior of LLM-based MAS, 27 of the 128 unsolved issues involve difficulties in reproducing the reported problems. Without accurately reproducing the problem within LLM-based MAS, it can be difficult for practitioners to identify root causes of the issues, thereby hindering the resolution of the issues. For example, practitioners reported that the “ transfer_task_to_member error occasionally occurs in some random cases when using the aprint_response method ” (Agno #3095), with multiple users experiencing different behaviors across versions. Identifying the root cause, in this case, a shared model instance issue, requires substantial investigation, highlighting the challenges of reproducing issues in LLM-based MAS and complicating their resolution. Therefore, future research could explore automated failure-reproduction techniques, controlled execution environments, and systematic test-case generation to improve the reproducibility of failures in LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-based MAS）具有复杂且动态的行为，在尚未解决的 128 个问题中，有 27 个涉及难以复现已报告的问题。 若无法在基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中准确复现问题，从业者将难以识别问题的根本原因，从而阻碍问题的解决。 例如，从业者报告称，“在使用 aprint_response 方法时，某些随机情况下偶尔会出现 transfer_task_to_member 错误”（Agno #3095），且不同用户在不同版本中遇到了不同的行为表现。 在这种情况下，要识别根本原因——即共享模型实例问题——需要进行大量调查，这凸显了在基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中复现问题的挑战，并使得问题解决更加复杂。 因此，未来研究可以探索自动故障复现技术、受控执行环境以及系统化的测试用例生成方法，以提高基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统中故障的复现性。

paragraphs.en: Memory & State Management Issue represents the second most frequent challenge in LLM-based MAS, accounting for 14.7% of all reported issues. Within this category, Context Loss and State Inconsistency are the most common types, indicating limitations in current memory mechanisms in LLM-based MAS. This finding is further supported by the root cause analysis, which identifies Memory Problem (MP) as the third most significant underlying cause among all identified causes, accounting for 11.1% of all reported causes. Memory & State Management Issue accounts for 51.1% of the issues caused by Memory Problem (MP) . This indicates that deficiencies in context propagation between agents, state synchronization across agents, and memory retrieval for agent interactions are major contributors to system failures in LLM-based MAS. We recommend that future research focus on developing reliable memory management mechanisms that ensure (1) consistent context propagation across agents during handoffs, (2) reliable state synchronization during parallel agent execution, and (3) effective context compression to prevent context overflow while preserving information essential for agent reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆与状态管理问题是在 LLM 基础多智能体系统（MAS）中第二常见的挑战，占所有报告问题的 14.7%。 在此类别中，上下文丢失和状态不一致是最常见的类型，表明当前 LLM 基础 MAS 的记忆机制存在局限性。 根本原因分析进一步支持了这一发现：记忆问题（MP）在所有已识别的根本原因中位列第三，占所有报告原因的 11.1%。 记忆与状态管理问题占由记忆问题（MP）引发的所有问题的 51.1%。 这表明，智能体之间的上下文传递缺陷、跨智能体的状态同步问题，以及用于智能体交互的记忆检索不足，是 LLM 基础 MAS 系统故障的主要诱因。 我们建议未来研究应专注于开发可靠的记忆管理机制，以确保：（1）在智能体交接过程中实现一致的上下文传递；（2）在智能体并行执行时实现可靠的状态同步；以及（3）通过有效的上下文压缩防止上下文溢出，同时保留智能体推理所需的关键信息。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity : In our study, data collection was conducted automatically using GitHub APIs, while data filtering and labeling involved both automated and manual processes. Since several phases, including manual filtering, open coding, constant comparison, and data extraction, were performed manually, the study may be subject to personal bias during the classification, labeling, and extraction of issues, causes, and solutions in LLM-based MAS. To reduce this risk and improve the objectivity and reliability of the results, pilot studies were conducted using both automated and manual approaches before each formal phase to evaluate the effectiveness of methods, prompts, and criteria across different researchers, thereby improving construct validity. Following each pilot and formal study, we first performed automated filtering to obtain initial results. The first author then conducted a manual analysis and discussed the findings with the second and third authors to reach a consensus on the results related to the RQs. Since open coding and constant comparison were mainly carried out by the first author, there is still a risk of subjective interpretation affecting the results. The first author’s six years of software development experience, along with two years of experience working with LLM-based MASs, helped mitigate this risk, although it could not be eliminated entirely. In addition, future work may adopt more advanced automated or semi-automated techniques to further reduce bias in data filtering, labeling, and extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度：在我们的研究中，数据收集是通过 GitHub API 自动完成的，而数据筛选和标注则结合了自动化和人工流程。 由于包括人工筛选、开放式编码、持续比较和数据提取在内的多个阶段均以人工方式执行，因此在基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中对问题、原因和解决方案进行分类、标注和提取时，研究可能会受到个人偏见的影响。 为降低这一风险并提升结果的客观性和可靠性，在正式研究的每个阶段之前，我们都通过自动化和人工方法进行了试点研究，以评估不同研究人员之间方法、提示词和标准的有效性，从而增强构念效度。 每次试点研究和正式研究结束后，我们首先执行自动化筛选以获得初步结果。 随后，第一作者进行了人工分析，并与第二和第三作者讨论研究结果，就与研究问题相关的结论达成共识。 由于开放式编码和持续比较主要由第一作者完成，因此主观解释仍可能对结果产生影响。 第一作者在软件开发领域拥有六年经验，并且有两年使用基于 LLM 的多智能体系统的经验，这有助于降低这一风险，尽管无法完全消除。 此外，未来的研究可以采用更先进的自动化或半自动化技术，进一步减少数据筛选、标注和提取中的偏见。

paragraphs.en: External validity : In our study, the main threat to external validity comes from the selection of data sources. To address this, we used the “Issues” pages of GitHub projects as the primary data source. GitHub is the largest platform for hosting open-source projects. Each project includes an “Issues” section. Practitioners use it to report bugs, errors, and development difficulties. It also allows discussion between users and developers. To extract more reliable information on causes and solutions, we focused on closed issues. These usually contain resolved discussions and more complete resolution details of issues. However, even with these selection choices, we acknowledge that the dataset may not fully represent all practices in the development and use of LLM-based MAS. Some relevant information may reside outside GitHub or in undocumented settings, which could be explored as potential sources in future work.

paragraphs.en: Reliability : To address potential uncertainties arising from the research methodology, we took several steps to improve the reliability of this study. As described in Section 2.3.1 , we first conducted pilot studies to check the agreement between the first and third authors on data labeling before starting the formal study. In this pilot phase, Cohen’s Kappa value was 0.82, which indicated a good level of agreement. During the data labeling, extraction, and analysis stages, we regularly discussed cases where there were differences in interpretation. These discussions helped us resolve disagreements and keep the results consistent across different stages of the study. This also improved the overall stability of the findings. In addition, the dataset used in this study has been made publicly available ( Rehman et al., 2026 ) , so that other researchers can replicate the study and validate the results independently.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠性：为了解决研究方法论可能带来的不确定性，我们采取了多项措施来提高本研究的可信度。 如第 2.3.1 节所述，在正式研究开始前，我们首先进行了试点研究，以检验第一和第三位作者在数据标注方面的一致性。 在此试点阶段，Cohen’s Kappa 值为 0.82，表明一致性程度良好。 在数据标注、提取和分析阶段，我们定期讨论了存在解释差异的案例。 这些讨论帮助我们解决了分歧，并确保了研究不同阶段的结果保持一致。 这也提升了研究结果的整体稳定性。 此外，本研究使用的数据集已公开提供（Rehman et al., 2026），以便其他研究人员能够重复该研究并独立验证结果。

sents.en: In this pilot phase, Cohen’s Kappa value was 0.82, which indicated a good level of agreement.
sents.zh: 在此试点阶段，Cohen’s Kappa 值为 0.82，表明一致性程度良好。

sents.en: During the data labeling, extraction, and analysis stages, we regularly discussed cases where there were differences in interpretation.
sents.zh: 在数据标注、提取和分析阶段，我们定期讨论了存在解释差异的案例。

sents.en: These discussions helped us resolve disagreements and keep the results consistent across different stages of the study.
sents.zh: 这些讨论帮助我们解决了分歧，并确保了研究不同阶段的结果保持一致。

sents.en: This also improved the overall stability of the findings.
sents.zh: 这也提升了研究结果的整体稳定性。

sents.en: In addition, the dataset used in this study has been made publicly available ( Rehman et al., 2026 ) , so that other researchers can replicate the study and validate the results independently.
sents.zh: 此外，本研究使用的数据集已公开提供（Rehman et al., 2026），以便其他研究人员能够重复该研究并独立验证结果。

paragraphs.en: The existing literature is organized into three categories. We first review empirical studies using software repository mining to investigate practitioner-reported issues, causes, and solutions in software systems and LLM-based projects in Section 6.1 . We then discuss LLM-based MAS for software engineering in Section 6.2 , followed by studies exploring challenges, failure patterns, and limitations of LLM-based MAS in Section 6.3 . Finally, we summarize the research gaps motivating this study in Section 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 现有文献被划分为三类。 首先，我们在第 6.1 节中回顾了利用软件仓库挖掘方法，研究实践者报告的软件系统和基于 LLM 的项目中的问题、原因及解决方案的经验性研究。 接着，我们在第 6.2 节中讨论了用于软件工程领域的基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS），随后在第 6.3 节中探讨了相关研究对基于 LLM 的 MAS 所面临的挑战、失败模式及其局限性的探索。 最后，我们在第 6.4 节中总结了推动本研究的研究空白。

paragraphs.en: Mining software repositories has become a widely used approach for understanding practitioner-reported issues, their underlying causes, and corresponding solutions. Waseem et al. (2021) conducted an empirical study to understand issues in open-source microservice systems. They manually analyzed 1,345 closed GitHub issues from five projects and developed a taxonomy of 17 issue categories. Their results show that Technical Debt , Build , and Security are the most frequently reported categories. They later extended this work by analyzing 2,641 GitHub issues from 15 open-source microservice systems. They also conducted 15 practitioner interviews and surveyed 150 practitioners. Based on these findings, they developed comprehensive taxonomies of issues, root causes, and solutions in microservice systems. Zhao et al. (2023b) conducted a large-scale empirical study of 570 performance issues from 13 open-source projects. They identified eight common root causes and corresponding solutions. Their findings show that 27% of the issues require design-level optimization, highlighting the importance of architectural improvements for addressing performance issues. With the growing adoption of AI and LLMs in software engineering, researchers have extended repository mining to investigate practitioner-reported issues in LLM-based projects. Cai et al. (2025b) analyzed 994 GitHub issues from 15 open-source LLM projects. They developed taxonomies of issue categories, root causes, and solutions. Their results show that Model Issue is the most common issue category, while Model Problem , Configuration Problem , and Connection Problem are the most frequent root causes. Model Optimization is the predominant solution. Zhou et al. (2025b) investigated GitHub Copilot, an LLM-based AI programming assistant, by analyzing 473 GitHub issues, 706 GitHub discussions, and 142 Stack Overflow posts. Their findings show that Operation Issue and Compatibility Issue are the most common problem categories. Copilot Internal Error , Network Connection Error , and IDE Compatibility Issue are the most frequent causes, while Bug Fixed by Copilot , Modify Configuration , and Use Suitable Version are the predominant solutions. Collectively, these studies establish a foundation for understanding practitioner-reported issues, their root causes, and solutions through repository mining across different software domains.
paragraphs.zh: 对软件仓库进行挖掘已成为理解从业者报告的问题、其根本原因及相应解决方案的一种广泛应用方法。Waseem 等人 （2021）开展了一项实证研究，旨在了解开源微服务系统中的问题。 他们手动分析了五个项目中的 1,345 个已关闭的 GitHub 问题，并建立了一个包含 17 类问题的分类体系。 他们的研究结果表明，技术债务、构建和安全是最常被报告的问题类别。 随后，他们通过分析 15 个开源微服务系统中的 2,641 个 GitHub 问题，扩展了这项研究。 他们还进行了 15 次从业者访谈，并对 150 名从业者进行了调查。 基于这些发现，他们建立了关于微服务系统中问题、根本原因和解决方案的综合分类体系。Zhao 等人 （2023b）对 13 个开源项目中的 570 个性能问题开展了一项大规模实证研究。 他们识别出八种常见的根本原因及相应的解决方案。 他们的研究结果表明，27% 的问题需要设计层面的优化，这凸显了架构改进在解决性能问题中的重要性。 随着人工智能和大型语言模型在软件工程中的广泛应用，研究人员已将仓库挖掘方法扩展至基于大型语言模型的项目中，以研究从业者报告的问题。Cai 等人 （2025b）分析了 15 个开源大型语言模型项目中的 994 个 GitHub 问题。 他们建立了关于问题类别、根本原因和解决方案的分类体系。 他们的研究结果表明，模型问题是最常见的问题类别，而模型故障、配置问题和连接问题是频率最高的根本原因。 模型优化是最主要的解决方案。Zhou 等人 （2025b）通过分析 473 个 GitHub 问题、706 条 GitHub 讨论和 142 篇 Stack Overflow 帖子，对基于大型语言模型的 AI 编程助手 GitHub Copilot 进行了研究。 他们的研究结果表明，操作问题和兼容性问题是最常见的问题类别。 Copilot 内部错误、网络连接错误和 IDE 兼容性问题是最频繁出现的原因，而“Copilot 已修复的漏洞”、“修改配置”和“使用合适的版本”则是最主要的解决方案。 综合来看，这些研究为通过仓库挖掘方法理解不同软件领域中从业者报告的问题及其根本原因和解决方案奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in LLMs have led to the emergence of LLM-based MAS, where multiple specialized agents collaborate to automate software engineering tasks. Qian et al. (2024) introduced ChatDev, a chat-powered software development framework that assigns specialized roles (e.g., CEO, CTO, Programmer, Reviewer, and Tester) to LLM-based agents. By using a chat chain to decompose tasks and support sequential interactions among agents, ChatDev enables collaborative software development and achieves an 88% executability score, reflecting the proportion of software projects generated by ChatDev that successfully compile and execute. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM-based MAS for software development. Likewise, Hong et al. (2024) introduced MetaGPT, a meta-programming framework that incorporates Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) into multi-agent collaboration. By assigning specialized roles to agents and enforcing structured workflows, MetaGPT enables agents to collaboratively perform software engineering tasks through role-based coordination. Similarly, Wu et al. (2024) introduced AutoGen, a generalized multi-agent conversation framework for developing LLM-based applications. AutoGen enables agents to perform tasks using LLMs, human feedback, and external tools, while supporting flexible communication patterns for designing complex multi-agent workflows. AutoGen achieves 69.48% accuracy on the MATH dataset, a standard benchmark comprising 12,500 high-school competition math problems, substantially outperforming vanilla GPT-4. In addition, Nguyen et al. (2025) introduced AgileCoder, a multi-agent software development framework inspired by Agile methodology. AgileCoder assigns specialized roles (e.g., Product Manager, Scrum Master, Developer, and Tester) to agents and organizes development into iterative sprints based on user feedback. It further introduces a Dynamic Code Graph Generator to maintain code dependencies and provide relevant context for code generation and modification. Evaluations on HumanEval, MBPP, and ProjectDev show that AgileCoder outperforms existing frameworks such as ChatDev and MetaGPT, demonstrating the effectiveness of integrating Agile principles into multi-agent software development. To provide a broader perspective on designing LLM-based MAS for software engineering tasks, Cai et al. (2025a) examined the quality attributes, design patterns, and design rationale adopted in existing LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 最近大语言模型（LLM）的进步催生了基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS），其中多个专业智能体通过协作来自动化软件工程任务。Qian等人 （2024）提出了ChatDev，一个基于聊天功能的软件开发框架，该框架为基于LLM的智能体分配了特定角色（例如，CEO、CTO、程序员、评审员和测试员）。 通过利用聊天链分解任务并支持智能体之间的顺序交互，ChatDev实现了协作式软件开发，并获得了88%的可执行性得分，这一分数反映了ChatDev生成的软件项目中成功编译和执行的比例。 这些结果证明了基于LLM的多智能体系统在软件开发中的有效性。同样地，Hong等人 （2024）提出了MetaGPT，一个元编程框架，它将标准操作程序（SOP）整合到了多智能体协作中。 通过为智能体分配特定角色并强制执行结构化工作流程，MetaGPT使智能体能够通过基于角色的协调来协作完成软件工程任务。类似地，Wu等人 （2024）提出了AutoGen，一个用于开发基于LLM应用程序的通用多智能体对话框架。 AutoGen使智能体能够利用LLM、人类反馈和外部工具执行任务，同时支持灵活的通信模式，以设计复杂的多智能体工作流程。 AutoGen在MATH数据集上实现了69.48%的准确率，该数据集是一个包含12,500道高中竞赛数学题的标准基准测试，其表现显著优于普通的GPT-4。 此外，Nguyen等人 （2025）提出了AgileCoder，一个受敏捷方法启发的多智能体软件开发框架。 AgileCoder为智能体分配了特定角色（例如，产品经理、Scrum主管、开发人员和测试员），并根据用户反馈将开发过程组织成迭代冲刺。 该框架还引入了动态代码图生成器，用于维护代码依赖关系，并为代码生成和修改提供相关上下文。 在HumanEval、MBPP和ProjectDev上的评估表明，AgileCoder的表现优于ChatDev和MetaGPT等现有框架，证明了将敏捷原则整合到多智能体软件开发中的有效性。 为了从更广泛的视角探讨如何为软件工程任务设计基于LLM的多智能体系统，Cai等人 （2025a）研究了现有基于LLM的多智能体系统在质量属性、设计模式和设计原理方面的应用情况。

paragraphs.en: Their analysis shows that Code Generation is the most frequently addressed software engineering task, Functional Suitability is the most emphasized quality attribute, and Role-Based Cooperation and Self-Reflection are the most commonly adopted design patterns. They also report that improving code quality and simulating human problem-solving are the primary motivations behind these design choices. Together, these studies demonstrate the effectiveness and growing adoption of LLM-based MAS for software engineering tasks. However, improving their real-world deployment requires a deeper understanding of the challenges practitioners encounter, their underlying causes, and potential solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 他们的分析表明，代码生成是最常被处理的软件工程任务，功能适用性是最受重视的质量属性，而基于角色的协作和自我反思则是最常用的设计模式。 他们还指出，提升代码质量和模拟人类问题解决过程是这些设计选择背后的主要动机。 综合来看，这些研究证明了基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统在软件工程任务中的有效性及其日益广泛的应用。 然而，要在实际环境中更好地部署这些系统，需要更深入地理解从业者所面临的挑战、其根本原因以及潜在的解决方案。

sents.en: Their analysis shows that Code Generation is the most frequently addressed software engineering task, Functional Suitability is the most emphasized quality attribute, and Role-Based Cooperation and Self-Reflection are the most commonly adopted design patterns.
sents.zh: 他们的分析表明，代码生成是最常被处理的软件工程任务，功能适用性是最受重视的质量属性，而基于角色的协作和自我反思则是最常用的设计模式。

sents.en: They also report that improving code quality and simulating human problem-solving are the primary motivations behind these design choices.
sents.zh: 他们还指出，提升代码质量和模拟人类问题解决过程是这些设计选择背后的主要动机。

sents.en: Together, these studies demonstrate the effectiveness and growing adoption of LLM-based MAS for software engineering tasks.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些研究证明了基于大型语言模型的多智能体系统在软件工程任务中的有效性及其日益广泛的应用。

sents.en: However, improving their real-world deployment requires a deeper understanding of the challenges practitioners encounter, their underlying causes, and potential solutions.
sents.zh: 然而，要在实际环境中更好地部署这些系统，需要更深入地理解从业者所面临的挑战、其根本原因以及潜在的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: While existing studies have demonstrated the potential of LLM-based MAS for software engineering tasks, recent research has started investigating the practical challenges, limitations, and failure patterns of these systems. Liu et al. (2025) conducted an empirical study of open-source LLM-based MAS frameworks by analyzing over 42,000 commits and 4,700 resolved issues across eight frameworks. They identified common development and maintenance issues, including bugs, infrastructure problems, and agent coordination challenges, highlighting the difficulties in building reliable MAS. Similarly, ( Asgari et al., 2026 ) investigated developer challenges in LLM-based MAS frameworks through Stack Overflow discussions and GitHub issues. Their study identified several challenges related to retrieval, agent memory, orchestration, execution control, and runtime reliability, which affect the development and maintenance of LLM-based MAS frameworks. Furthermore, Hamid et al. (2026) explored practitioner difficulties in agentic frameworks by analyzing 2,658 Stack Overflow posts. They identified challenges related to framework configuration, tool integration, vector database operations, and agent execution behavior, with runtime-related issues emerging as particularly challenging to address. In addition, Cemri et al. (2025) analyzed over 1,600 execution traces from seven LLM-based MAS frameworks and proposed the MAS Failure Taxonomy (MAST), identifying 14 failure modes across different stages of agent execution. These studies provide insights into LLM-based MAS challenges and failure patterns; however, a comprehensive understanding of practitioner-reported issues, their causes, and solutions remains limited. This study addresses this gap through empirical analysis of the issues of LLM-based MAS.

paragraphs.en: Software repository mining has been widely used to investigate practitioner-reported issues, their root causes, and solutions in software systems, providing a foundation for understanding real-world development challenges ( Waseem et al., 2026 ) . With the increasing adoption of LLMs in software engineering, researchers have extended repository mining approaches to study issues in LLM-based software systems ( Cai et al., 2025b ) . Recently, LLM-based MAS have attracted significant attention by enabling multiple LLM-powered specialized agents to collaboratively perform complex software engineering tasks beyond the capabilities of single-agent LLMs, leading to the development of various frameworks and techniques, such as ChatDev and AgileCoder ( Qian et al., 2024 ; Nguyen et al., 2025 ) . However, relatively few studies have investigated the practical issues, failure patterns, and maintenance challenges of LLM-based MAS ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, existing studies on LLM-based MAS provide only limited understanding of the practical problems faced by practitioners, their underlying causes, and the solutions adopted in real-world LLM-based MAS projects. To address this gap, we conducted an empirical analysis of closed GitHub issues from LLM-based MAS projects to derive taxonomies of issues, their underlying causes, and solutions. The comparison with existing studies is summarized in Table 10 .

paragraphs.en: In this study, we investigated the issues that practitioners encounter when developing and using open-source LLM-based MAS, as well as their underlying causes and potential solutions. We collected 22,848 closed issues from open-source LLM-based MAS on GitHub that met our inclusion criteria, as shown in Table 2 . Then, we applied a mixed automated and manual filtering approach to reduce the dataset to 944 issues related to LLM-based MAS. Finally, we extracted 944 issues, 540 causes, and 427 solutions based on our data extraction criteria. Our results show that Orchestration & Execution Issue is the most common issue faced by practitioners. Workflow Problem (WP) , Tool Integration Problem (TIP) , and Memory Problem (MP) are identified as the most frequent causes of the issues, while Optimize Workflow (OW) was employed as the predominant solution to address the issues.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了实践者在开发和使用基于开源 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）时所遇到的问题，以及这些问题的根本原因和潜在解决方案。 我们从 GitHub 上收集了 22,848 个符合纳入标准的基于开源 LLM 的多智能体系统的关闭问题，如表 2 所示。 随后，我们采用自动化与人工相结合的过滤方法，将数据集缩减为 944 个与基于 LLM 的多智能体系统相关的问题。 最后，根据我们的数据提取标准，我们提取了 944 个问题、540 个原因和 427 个解决方案。 我们的研究结果表明，“协调与执行问题”是实践者面临的最常见的问题。 “工作流问题”（WP）、“工具集成问题”（TIP）和“记忆问题”（MP）被确定为这些问题最频繁的原因，而“优化工作流”（OW）则是解决这些问题的主要方案。

paragraphs.en: Based on the study results, we provide implications for users, developers, and researchers of open-source LLM-based MAS. Users can address the most frequent Orchestration & Execution Issue through explicit handoff design between agents and multi-agent execution controls, such as retry limits, timeouts, and monitoring mechanisms in LLM-based MAS. They can also refine prompt design to obtain more reliable responses from LLM-based MAS. Developers can improve tool integration reliability through schema validation, execution controls, and tool connection management in LLM-based MAS. Researchers can explore methods to reproduce and diagnose unsolved issues and develop reliable memory management mechanisms to improve context propagation between agents, state synchronization across agents, and memory retrieval for agent interactions in LLM-based MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 基于研究结果，我们为开源 LLM 基 MAS 的用户、开发者和研究人员提供了相关建议。 用户可以通过智能体之间的显式交接设计以及 LLM 基 MAS 中的多智能体执行控制（例如重试限制、超时和监控机制）来解决最常见的编排与执行问题。 他们还可以通过优化提示词设计，从 LLM 基 MAS 中获得更可靠的响应。 开发者可以通过 LLM 基 MAS 中的模式验证、执行控制和工具连接管理来提高工具集成的可靠性。 研究人员可以探索重现和诊断未解决问题以及开发可靠记忆管理机制的方法，以改善 LLM 基 MAS 中智能体之间的上下文传播、跨智能体的状态同步以及智能体交互的记忆检索。
